records.description:
We anticipate the application window for this opening will close on - 6 Dec 2026 
 

Careers that change lives start here. Medtronic is a global leader in healthcare technology with a Mission to alleviate pain, restore health, and extend life. Our 95,000 employees work across more than 150 countries to put patients first — developing innovative medical technologies that improve the lives of 72+ million patients each year. Your unique talents will help shape the future of healthcare while building a career grounded in purpose, growth, and impact.

**A Day in the Life**
=====================

At Medtronic, you can begin a life-long career of exploration and innovation while helping champion healthcare access and equity for all. You'll lead with purpose, breaking down barriers to innovation in a more connected, compassionate world. We work with a sense of purpose and ownership, knowing there is a human life on the other side of every decision.
 
 
In this enterprise leadership role, the Director, Quality Center of Expertise (COE) – Design Quality will advance Design and Development excellence across Medtronic by shaping strategy, standards, governance, and enterprise capability for Design Quality and product development processes. Supporting every Medtronic Operating Unit and product category, this leader will drive consistency, strengthen Design Control execution, improve organizational capability, and help teams successfully navigate complex product development challenges.
 
 
The ideal candidate brings deep Design Quality and product development expertise, strong technical credibility, and a demonstrated track record of leading through complexity to deliver business, quality, and patient-focused outcomes. This individual will be a trusted enterprise partner who collaborates across Operating Units, Core Quality Services, and executive leadership teams to remove barriers, accelerate progress, and enable innovation while maintaining the highest standards of quality, compliance, and patient safety.
 
 
At Medtronic, we bring bold ideas forward with speed and decisiveness to put patients first in everything we do. In-person collaboration is critical to the success of this enterprise leadership role. This position requires an on-site presence a minimum of four days per week and must be based at one of the Medtronic U.S. campuses listed below. 

**Work Location**

This position will be onsite and based at one of the following Medtronic locations in the contiguous United States:

* Mounds View, MN / Minneapolis, MN (Twin Cities Campus)
* Irvine, CA / Santa Ana, CA (Orange County Campus)
* Lafayette, CO (Colorado Campus)
* Greater Boston Area (Boston, Danvers, or Mansfield, MA)
* North Haven, CT
* Memphis, TN
* Fort Worth, TX
* Jacksonville, FL
* Tempe, AZ

Travel up to 20% is required.

 

As **Director, Quality Center of Expertise (COE) – Design Quality** , you will provide enterprise leadership for Design Quality across Medtronic's global portfolio of medical technologies. You will partner with Operating Unit, Quality, Regulatory, Engineering, Product Development, and executive leaders to strengthen Design and Development practices, improve Design Control effectiveness, and enable successful execution across a diverse range of products and technologies.

You will serve as a highly credible Design Quality leader and trusted advisor, helping teams solve complex product development challenges while driving strategic initiatives that improve quality outcomes, product safety, regulatory readiness, and organizational performance.

Success in this role requires the ability to influence across a highly matrixed organization while maintaining a hands-on approach that removes barriers and accelerates execution. You will lead a small team of experts while driving enterprise-wide impact through collaboration, technical leadership, and capability building.

Responsibilities may include the following and other duties may be assigned:

 

***Lead enterprise Design Quality strategy, standards, and governance.***

* Develop and execute the enterprise Design Quality strategy, governance model, standards, and service priorities across Medtronic's global product portfolio.
* Establish and maintain enterprise Design Quality standards that enable consistent execution, regulatory readiness, and risk-based decision making.
* Own enterprise Design Quality process health, KPI visibility, and performance management mechanisms to identify trends, elevate risks, and drive timely action.
Create and lead governance mechanisms supporting critical product development programs, including escalation, issue resolution, and cross-functional decision making. 

***Drive enterprise initiatives and cross-functional partnerships that improve product development effectiveness, quality, and patient safety.***

* Partner with Operating Unit development teams to address complex design and development challenges through technical consultation, coaching, and expert guidance.
* Drive enterprise initiatives focused on improving product development effectiveness, product quality, patient safety, and risk management.
* Lead and influence strategic initiatives across the DRM Council, Productivity Workstream, Software Excellence Workstream, Global Operations & Supply Chain (GOSC), and Core Quality Services.
* Advance enterprise priorities, including Predicate Product Risk Reduction (PPRR) and other high-impact Design Quality improvement initiatives.
Partner with other Quality Centers of Excellence, including Risk Management, CAPA, and Acquisitions, to ensure alignment across critical quality processes. 

***Serve as the enterprise Design Quality expert, building capability and influencing critical decisions.***

* Serve as the enterprise subject matter expert for Design Quality, Design Controls, and Design & Development excellence.
* Build enterprise Design Quality capability through coaching, mentoring, talent development, and deployment of best practices.
* Influence decisions with potential enterprise-wide impact involving product safety, compliance, regulatory risk, legal exposure, business performance, and Medtronic's reputation.
Foster a culture of collaboration, accountability, technical excellence, continuous improvement, and patient focus. 

 

**Must Have: Minimum Requirements**

 

**To be considered for this role, please ensure the minimum requirements are evident on your resume.**

* Bachelor's degree required and 10+ years of relevant experience in Product Development, Design Quality, Quality Engineering, Quality Systems, or related leadership roles **OR** Advanced degree with 8+ years of relevant experience in Product Development, Design Quality, Quality Engineering, Quality Systems, or related leadership roles.
* Minimum of 7 years of people leadership experience.
* Demonstrated experience leading Design Quality and Design Control activities within regulated medical device, software, combination product, or similarly regulated industries.
* Demonstrated experience leading Design & Development, Design Quality, or Product Development initiatives across multiple business units, product platforms, or enterprise functions within a complex, matrixed organization.
Experience supporting the development, design transfer, or lifecycle management of regulated medical technologies. 

 

**Nice to Have**

 

***Product development and Design Quality experience across the lifecycle.***

* Extensive experience serving on product development Core Teams through multiple phases of the product lifecycle.
* Demonstrated success leading complex product development or Design Quality challenges across diverse technologies and product categories.
Experience leading enterprise-wide quality, product development, or transformation initiatives across multiple business units. 

***Deep technical, regulatory, and digital expertise.***

* Deep expertise in Design Controls, Design Verification and Validation, Risk Management, and Design & Development processes.
* Strong knowledge of FDA regulations, QMSR, ISO 13485, EU MDR, GMP, and other global regulatory requirements.
* Experience supporting software-enabled medical technologies, digital health products, combination products, or other complex regulated technologies.
Experience leveraging analytics, AI-enabled tools, automation, and digital technologies to improve quality performance and organizational effectiveness. 

***Leadership through influence in a highly matrixed environment.***

* Proven ability to build alignment and influence decision-making among technical experts, business leaders, and executive stakeholders.
* Demonstrated success leading through influence in a highly matrixed environment while delivering large-scale organizational impact.
* Hands-on leadership style with a demonstrated ability to remove barriers, accelerate execution, and deliver measurable business outcomes.

For Baccalaureate degrees earned outside of the United States, a degree that satisfies the requirements of 8 C.F.R. § 214.2(h)(4)(iii)(A) is required.

**Physical Job Requirements**

The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this position, but they are not an exhaustive list of all the required responsibilities and skills of this position.

The physical demands described within the Responsibilities section of this job description are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. For Office Roles: While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to be independently mobile. The employee is also required to interact with a computer, and communicate with peers and co-workers. Contact your manager or local HR to understand the Work Conditions and Physical requirements that may be specific to each role.

**U.S. Work Authorization & Sponsorship**

At Medtronic, we are committed to fostering an environment where employees can thrive and make a meaningful impact. In alignment with our enterprise-wide workforce planning approach, U.S. work authorization sponsorship (H-1B, TN, J, etc.) is offered exclusively for Principal-level roles and above, where specialized expertise aligns with long-term business needs. Roles below the Principal level require candidates to possess unrestricted U.S. work authorization at the time of hire and for the duration of employment.
‌

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**

We are aware of phishing scams targeting job seekers. Please keep the following in mind:

 

Apply only through official Medtronic channels. All legitimate Medtronic recruiting communications come from approved Medtronic platforms and official @medtronic.com email addresses.

 

Medtronic will never ask for payment or sensitive personal information (such as bank account or Social Security details) during early stages of the hiring process. Any such requests are not legitimate.

 

If you receive a suspicious message claiming to be from Medtronic, do not respond, click links, or open attachments.

 

If you have any questions, concerns regarding the authenticity of a communication alleged to have been made by or on behalf of Medtronic, please contact us immediately at AskHR@medtronic.com .
‌

**Benefits & Compensation**
===========================

**Medtronic offers a competitive Salary and flexible Benefits Package** 
A commitment to our employees lives at the core of our values. We recognize their contributions. They share in the success they help to create. We offer a wide range of benefits, resources, and competitive compensation plans designed to support you at every career and life stage.

Salary ranges for U.S (excl. PR) locations (USD):$184,000.00 - $276,000.00
‌ 
This position is eligible for a short-term incentive called the Medtronic Incentive Plan (MIP).The base salary range is applicable across the United States, excluding Puerto Rico and specific locations in California. The offered rate complies with federal and local regulations and may vary based on factors such as experience, certification/education, market conditions, and location. Compensation and benefits information pertains solely to candidates hired within the United States (local market compensation and benefits will apply for others).

The following benefits and additional compensation are available to those regular employees who work 20+ hours per week: Health, Dental and vision insurance , Health Savings Account , Healthcare Flexible Spending Account , Life insurance, Long-term disability leave , Dependent daycare spending account , Tuition assistance/reimbursement , and Simple Steps (global well-being program).

The following benefits and additional compensation are available to all regular employees: Incentive plans, 401(k) plan plus employer contribution and match , Short-term disability , Paid time off , Paid holidays , Employee Stock Purchase Plan , Employee Assistance Program , Non-qualified Retirement Plan Supplement (subject to IRS earning minimums) , and Capital Accumulation Plan (available to Vice Presidents and above, or subject to IRS earning minimums).

Regular employees are those who are not temporary, such as interns. Temporary employees are eligible for paid sick time, as required under applicable state law, and the Employee Stock Purchase Plan. Please note some of the above benefits may not apply to workers in Puerto Rico.

Further details are available at the link below:

Medtronic benefits and compensation plans

It is the policy of Medtronic to provide equal employment opportunity (EEO) to all persons regardless of age, color, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, race, religion, creed, gender, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, genetic information, marital status, status with regard to public assistance, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. In addition, Medtronic will provide reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities.

 

If you are applying to perform work for Medtronic, Inc. (“Medtronic”) in any position which will involve performing at least two (2) hours of work on average each week within the unincorporated areas of Los Angeles County, you can find here a list of all material job duties of the specific job position which Medtronic reasonably believes that criminal history may have a direct, adverse and negative relationship potentially resulting in the withdrawal of a conditional offer of employment. Medtronic will consider for employment qualified job applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act.

records.description:
**About Bora:**

Bora Biologics is a global biologics CDMO delivering integrated development and GMP manufacturing solutions from First‑in‑Human through licensed commercial supply. While many CDMOs are structured primarily for early clinical programs, Bora Biologics is purpose‑built for commercialization. Our inspection‑proven, bi‑coastal U.S. manufacturing platform and integrated development center provide the infrastructure, regulatory discipline, and operational precision required for sustained global market supply.

**Summary**

Reporting to the VP, Regional Head of Quality, the BBUL Site Head of Quality is responsible for developing, implementing, and overseeing a comprehensive Quality Management strategy aligned with corporate policies, client expectations, and global regulatory requirements. This role ensures products from development through commercialization are safe, effective, and fully compliant with applicable CGMP/GxP standards. As a key member of the site leadership team, the Director/Sr. Director of Quality provides strategic and operational leadership for the Quality organization, which includes Quality Assurance and Quality Control. The role partners cross-functionally with all departments to foster a strong culture of quality, accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement while ensuring regulatory compliance and client satisfaction. The Director/Sr. Director also directs day-to-day quality operations, drives operational excellence and process optimization, supports execution of strategic and tactical initiatives, and ensures timely resolution of quality and compliance issues to maintain business performance and inspection readiness.

 

**Essential Functions**

*Reasonable accommodations will be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.*

* P rovide strategic leadership and overall accountability for the site Quality Management System (QMS), ensuring compliance with global policies, procedures, CGMP/GxP standards, and applicable regulatory requirements across the U.S. and international markets including EU.
* Partner with the Site Leadership Team (SLT) to strengthen and sustain a proactive culture of quality, escalating significant compliance risks and driving timely, effective resolution of quality issues.
* Lead and oversee regulatory inspections and audits, ensuring inspection readiness, effective agency interactions, and timely, compliant responses to observations.
* Direct all core Quality functions, including batch record review, material and product disposition, deviations and change control, document control, QC, QA oversight of all GMP functions including validation, operations, and facility activities.
* Provide leadership to ensure uninterrupted support for successful product transfers through robust quality oversight and operational excellence.
* Serve as the senior Quality leader supporting development initiatives and phased clinical programs, ensuring appropriate compliance throughout product development activities.
* Lead the Quality organization in achieving operational and strategic objectives, including budget planning and management, workforce planning, project execution, and organizational effectiveness.
* Establish and monitor key quality metrics (e.g., deviations, CAPAs, change controls, product release) to foster accountability. Evaluate system effectiveness and drive corrective action.
* Oversee quality indicators and operational efficiencies, implementing action plans to mitigate risks and streamline quality processes.
* Build, mentor, and develop a high-performing Quality organization that operates as a trusted, collaborative business partner, while driving talent development, succession planning, and employee growth.
* Establish clear, consistent, and effective communication across the Quality organization and with cross-functional stakeholders to ensure alignment on priorities, risks, and business objectives.
Perform additional responsibilities and strategic initiatives as assigned 

*The above statements are intended to describe the nature of work performed by those in this job and are not an exhaustive list of all duties. Nothing in this job description restricts managements right to assign or reassign duties and responsibilities to this job at any time which reflects management’s assignment of essential functions.*

**Minimum Education, Experience and Skills**

Bachelor’s degree in life sciences or a related area of study

**Experience:**

* At minumum15 years of pharmaceutical industry experience with at least 10 years of Quality experience, both QC and QA in biopharma/biotech in a CGMP pharmaceutical manufacturing environment with early and late-stage products.
* 5+ years of senior leadership experience driving Quality strategy, compliance initiatives, continuous improvement and staff development.
* Extensive experience developing, implementing and improving quality systems directly related to biologics drug substance manufacturing CGMP
* Proven track record of successfully managing and leading regulatory inspections, audits, and remediation activities with global health authorities with demonstrated success in leading a company through cGMP pre-approval and post-approval inspections.
* Proven ability to build and sustain a transparent, collaborative, and quality-focused culture that promotes accountability, engagement, and operational performance.
* Demonstrated experience leading cross-functional teams and influencing organizational change within complex regulated environments.
* Demonstrated ability to develop staff at all levels.
Experience with developing and managing budgets. 

**Skills and Abilities**

* Strong working knowledge of global regulatory requirements and quality standards, including US FDA, EMA, PIC/S, and ICH guidelines.
* Demonstrated success in leading organizations through sound decision-making, strategic problem-solving, and effective communication at all levels of the business.
* Prior experience within a CDMO environment is strongly preferred
* Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to influence stakeholders and communicate complex quality and compliance matters clearly and effectively.
* Proven ability to lead, mentor, and support teams through crisis management, organizational transformation, cultural change, and business growth initiatives.
* Highly adaptable and resilient, with the ability to perform effectively in fast-paced, high-pressure environments while maintaining focus on priorities and outcomes.
* Strong leadership capability with a demonstrated ability to empower teams, identify high-potential talent, and drive employee development and succession planning.
* Results-oriented leader with strong analytical and problem-solving skills focused on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
* Skilled at building trusted relationships and collaborating effectively with cross-functional peers, senior leadership, clients, and regulatory agencies.

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Advanced degree in biological or chemical sciences
* Experience with US FDA, China FDA, Health Canada, EMEA, PMDA, and ANVISA is preferred
* Knowledge of and experience with GLP and/or GCP regulatory inspections a plus
Strong operational excellence experience or qualification 

Base Salary Range 192000-270000

 
 

**Compensation and Benefits**

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support our employees’ wellbeing, including:

* Competitive salary and performance-based incentives
* Comprehensive health coverage including medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Retirement savings plans with employer matching contributions
* Paid time off
* Professional development opportunities
* Employee wellness programs and resources
* Employee Assistance Program and Mental Health Resources

**Core Values**

*At Bora, our values guide everything we do — from how we solve challenges to how we support our people. We lead with a solutions-first mindset, strive to do the right thing, stay proactive, and above all, respect everyone.*

Bora Pharmaceuticals is committed to providing equal employment opportunity to all applicants and employees according to all applicable equal opportunity and affirmative action laws, directives and regulations of federal, state and local governing bodies and agencies. records.description:
* Team:Industrial Operations & Product Supply
* Location:Saratoga Springs
* Req ID:R53236
* Contract:Full time
* Work Pattern:Onsite

**The role**
------------

**Build our future together:**

At Regeneron, we use science and innovation to develop life-changing medicines for people with serious diseases. We’re hiring a Sr. Director/Executive Director of Quality for our new highly automated bulk/ drug substance manufacturing plant, supporting 20–30 tech transfers a year alongside commercial delivery responsibility. GMP production will run concurrently with construction and CQV for 3–5 years. This role requires both building and operating.

 
 

This site operates on a foundation of strategy, execution, and rigor. Every function at the site owns a pyramid of metrics derived from annual goal planning that connects the site’s strategic goals to the factory floor, with performance measured back up to leadership to monitor, track, and mitigate against contingencies quantified using SMART goals in days and dollars.

 
 

The Sr. Director/Executive Director of Quality leads all aspects of site Quality Control and Quality Assurance operations including QA Operations, QA Systems, QA Validation, and QC. In this role you’ll lead the site quality system and culture, batch disposition, and inspection readiness. This role owns and manages all regulatory inspections; and represents the site’s conduit for quality metrics, quality system work, and transformational quality strategy to bring Regeneron to best-in-class lean quality operations. They will oversee and preserve our quality independence from operational pressure while partnering closely with site leadership.

 
 

**When & where:**

* Location: Saratoga Springs, New York, United States

* Work model: Monday-Friday, 8am-4:30pm
 

 

**Discover your role:**

* Own the site quality system (both QA &QC) and lead a culture of compliance, accountability, and right-first-time execution

* + QA: ops, systems, and validation owned directly alongside QC as part of a unified site quality organization

* + QC: responsible for delivering utilities, in-process and release testing, performing environmental monitoring, QC laboratory compliance, and method transfer support that enable timely, compliant batch release

* Oversee these functions OpEx and CapEx budget and roadmap

* Serve as the primary party responsible for this function's alignment with the Global Center of Excellence (COE), connecting site execution back to the business-level function

* Ensure this function's metrics flow up and down through the MDI structure, connecting into the site's S&OP, AOP, and long-range planning cycles

* Hold batch disposition authority, ensuring compliance and timely batch release

* Own and manage all regulatory inspections ensuring the site is continuously inspection-ready and leading the site through regulatory agency inspections and customer and corporate audits

* Serve as the site's primary conduit for quality metrics, quality system work, and l quality strategy connecting site execution to enterprise quality’s vision for best-in-class lean quality operations

* Provide governance of laboratory investigations, deviations, and CAPA management across all quality sub-functions

* Lead all aspects of batch record review and disposition support, floor quality presence, and deviation management for manufacturing for Saratoga Site

* Lead all aspects of QMS administration, document control, training compliance, CAPA system administration, and audit readiness for Saratoga Site

* Build and coordinate best-in-class validation programs process, cleaning, and equipment validation grounded in FDA's three-stage process validation lifecycle (Stage 1 Process Design, Stage 2 Process Qualification/PPQ, Stage 3 Continued Process Verification), EU Annex 15, ASTM E2500 risk-based qualification, and ICH Q8–Q11 Quality by Design principles tailored to large-molecule biotech manufacturing, including PPQ support for new suite introduction

* Lead quality readiness for suites entering service, including validation, qualification, and quality system scale-up

* Partner with manufacturing, technical services, technical operations, and supply chain as a core member of the site leadership team

* Own quality's role in the digital and connected plant model, including electronic quality systems, review by exception, and data integrity by design

* Build, coach, and retain a high-performing quality organization; establish high standards for performance management and accountability; perform other duties as required

* Lead a gross margin improvement program and goal for this function, contributing to the site's overall margin performance

* Own and manage the site’s data governance program, including data integrity standards, data ownership and accountability, lifecycle controls, and periodic review, so data is reliable from the floor to leadership reporting

* Own and manage the site’s quality management maturity, including assessing current state against enterprise and industry benchmarks, setting the improvement roadmap, and driving measurable gains in quality system performance

* Own and manage the site’s contamination control strategy, including its design, governance, and day-to-day execution across facility, equipment, process, personnel, and materials, with ongoing trending and review of effectiveness
 

 
 

**This role requires:**

* B.S in Life Sciences, Engineering, or a related technical field

* + Sr. Director: 15+ years in biopharmaceutical quality, large-molecule drug substance operations and/or medical device quality including 7+ years of progressive quality leadership

* + Executive Director: 18+ years in biopharmaceutical quality, large-molecule drug substance operations and/or medical device quality experience including 7+ years of progressive quality leadership

* + Level will be determined based on experience

* Experience with batch disposition and release decision-making in a GMP environment

* Previous people leadership/supervisory experience

Does this sound like you? Apply now to take your first step towards living the Regeneron Way! We are committed to building a workplace with an inclusive culture. Regeneron is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief (or lack thereof), sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, civil status, pregnancy or parental status, age, disability, nationality, citizenship status, ethnic or national origin, membership of the Traveler community, familial status, genetic information, military or veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law. Where required, we will provide reasonable accommodation to applicants with known disabilities or chronic illnesses during the recruitment process, unless such accommodation would impose undue hardship.

Where necessary, we disclose salary ranges for roles in all countries in which we operate. The final offer will be determined within the relevant range based on the country of employment, specific role level, and your skills and experience. In some countries, collective bargaining agreements (CBAs) may apply and influence certain elements of pay or benefits. Regeneron offers a competitive and comprehensive total rewards package which may include, depending on country and role: annual bonuses or other incentive plans, equity awards, pension or retirement benefits, 401(k) company match, health and wellness programs, fitness centers, insurance benefits (e.g. medical, dental, vision, life and disability), paid time off, and family support benefits. For additional information about Regeneron benefits in the U.S., please visit https://careers.regeneron.com/en/working-at-regeneron/total-rewards/. For other locations, additional information will be provided during the recruitment process. If you have any questions, please speak with your recruiter.

 
 

Please be advised that at Regeneron, we believe we do our best work when we are together. For that reason, many roles are required to be performed on‑site. Please speak with your recruiter and hiring manager for more information about on‑site expectations for your role and location.

 
 

As part of the recruitment process, certain background checks may be conducted in accordance with the laws of the country where the position is based. The purpose of such checks is to verify certain information prior to the commencement of employment such as identity, right to work and educational qualifications.

 
 

For jobs in Canada: this posting is for an existing position.

 
 

**Salary Range (annually)**

$207,000.00 - $407,400.00

records.description:
**Head of Site Quality**

**New Jersey, USA | On-site | Dechra Pharmaceuticals**

This is a rare opportunity to shape the quality strategy, expansion and future of a world-class sterile pharmaceutical manufacturing site.

As Head of Site Quality, you will provide strategic leadership across Quality Assurance, Quality Control, Microbiology and Quality Systems for a growing manufacturing operation producing biologic monoclonal antibodies and sterile pharmaceutical products for global markets. You will play a pivotal role in driving quality strategy, regulatory compliance, operational excellence and site expansion.

We're seeking an inspiring quality leader who can combine deep technical expertise with strong commercial awareness, building high-performing teams while maintaining the highest standards of compliance in a complex GMP environment.

**The Opportunity**

You will:

Lead all site quality functions, including QA, QC, Microbiology and Quality Systems.

Own inspection readiness and lead interactions with FDA, USDA and international regulatory authorities.

Provide quality leadership across aseptic manufacturing, sterilisation, lyophilisation and packaging operations.

Drive a culture of continuous improvement, accountability and operational excellence.

Partner with senior stakeholders across Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Regulatory Affairs and Technical Operations.

Support site expansion, technology transfer activities and future biologics capabilities.

**What We're Looking For**

You will be an experienced pharmaceutical quality leader with a proven track record in aseptic manufacturing environments and a passion for developing people and building quality cultures.

**Key requirements include:**

Significant technical QA experience within pharmaceutical or biopharmaceutical quality.

Significant leadership experience in **aseptic manufacturing** operations.

Deep knowledge of GMP, aseptic processing and contamination control strategies.

Knowledge of isolator fillers would be desirable but not essential.

Experience leading FDA and EU inspections with successful outcomes.

Expertise across quality systems, batch disposition, deviation management and regulatory compliance.

Strong stakeholder management and influencing skills.

Degree qualified in Pharmacy, Biological Sciences, Microbiology, Chemistry, Engineering or a related discipline.

**Why Join Dechra?**

At Dechra, we're driven by a shared purpose of supporting animal health worldwide. You'll join a business where quality is fundamental to success, where investment in people is a priority, and where you'll have the opportunity to make a lasting impact on a strategically important manufacturing site.

If you're ready to lead quality for a complex sterile manufacturing operation and help shape a new site and the next phase of our growth, we'd love to hear from you!

records.title: Director of Quality Improvement Strategy
records.description:
**About CCNC:**

From the mountains to the coast, from large cities to small towns, Community Care of North Carolina is transforming health care. Informed by statewide data and predictive analytics, community-based care-managers work with local physicians and diverse teams of health professionals to develop whole-person plans of care that connect people to the right local resources and increase equity and access to high quality care.

**CCNC Mission Statement**

To improve the health and quality of life for all North Carolinians by building supporting better community-based healthcare delivery systems.

**Position Summary**
====================

The Director of Quality Improvement (QI) Strategy is responsible for setting the vision for the organization’s Quality Improvement strategy, in collaboration with the Population Health Division and aligned with CCNC’s mission and strategic goals. The aim of the QI strategy is to ensure the CCPN member practices deliver high - quality health care that drives successful performance of the Clinically Integrated Network (CIN).

The Director of Quality Improvement (QI) Strategy in coordination with the Clinical Performance and Practice Engagement teams, will direct, plan, implement, monitor, coordinate, and evaluate all aspects of the QI strategy and oversee daily operations to ensure that CCNC’s strategic plan is implemented. implements and informs process improvement to create standardized and streamlined processes, workflows, and education. The Director of QI Strategy provides direct supervision of the QI Specialist and the Value Based Care Program Specialist.

Responsibilities include outreach, education, training, hands-on participative leadership, and development of an increased capacity to successfully execute performance improvement across the organization. Working directly with others across the organization, The Director of Quality Improvement (QI) Strategy ensures that the elements of the QI strategy allow for coordination and collaboration of multifaceted initiatives with practices that serve our covered populations with consideration of resources, cost savings and quality. This includes providing strategic input on the development of organizational goals, to include measurement criteria and interventions for achieving the goals.

**Essential Functions**
=======================

**Operationalize QI Strategy**
------------------------------

* Direct the implementation of Quality Improvement efforts to support CCPN practices and CCNC programming in accordance with the strategic plan.
* Establish and implement the process for how PRRs utilize the QI plans to drive performance with CCPN practices.
* Facilitate the development of programs, systems, workflows, and integration efforts in alignment with CCNC and CCPN’s contractual, regulatory and quality requirements.
* Apply QI methodology, change management strategies, team facilitation, and coaching principles to achieve program effectiveness and efficiencies.
* Mentor and train on QI methodology, change management, and coaching principles (e.g. Model for Improvement, PDSA, Lean,).
* Demonstrate subject matter expertise and knowledge of payment models and their associated quality measures.
* Serve as the subject matter expert and lead for key projects and initiatives; including developing detailed work plans, assigning responsibilities, monitoring project progress and ensuring spread and sustainability.
* Assist CCPN and CCNC with future program development, creation or delegation of accountability and ownership for program roles and continuous process improvement.
* Develop annual Quality Plans with the Value Based Care Program practices in coordination with key focus areas identified by Clinical Performance.
* Represent and demonstrate our QI strategy in monthly Joint Operating Council meetings with the Value Based Care Program practices.
* Support the Practice Based Care Coordination (PBCC) program through data mining, identification of opportunities for improvement, regular practice monitoring, and ongoing training & support for the QIPS team.
* Engage and maintain collaborative relationships with the health care community, including but not limited to primary care providers, practice managers & practice team members, health departments, FQHCs and other community partners.
* Serve as Liaison on local, regional and state workgroups and collaborative efforts.
* Partner with the QI leaders for payers to establish collaborative and effective working relationships.
* Actively participate in payer meetings to represent and demonstrate our QI strategy

***Data Management, Analytics and Presentation***

* Lead QI efforts to positively impact performance and quality measures.
* Collaborate with the Clinical Performance team to use data to evaluate the effectiveness of projects across departments
* Advise leadership on project-specific data and information needs in support of staff.
* Identify areas of opportunity for CCPN practices through clinical data analysis, interpretation, & presentation.
* Lead the QI PS team to provide excellent training and support to member practices that facilitate effective use of the organization’s value-based care data platform
* In coordination with the Clinical Performance team, train on data definitions, data interpretation and data analysis
* Support all programs in achieving program goals through data analytics and quality improvement support.
* Adhere to CCNC privacy and security policies to ensure that patient and company data are properly safeguarded.

***Staff Management and Supervision***

* Provide effective leadership with respect to recruitment, selection, training, evaluation, compensation, staff development, and advocacy for the QI Strategy Team.
* Provide oversight and guidance to staff through a team approach that allows for coordinated handoffs, communication, and workflow across provider-facing staff
* Develop strategies for allocating QI resources to meet program goals and to control costs through effective use of personnel.
* Identify staff training needs and provide appropriate training opportunities.
* Complete performance evaluations.
* Utilize conflict resolution and problem-solving skills to manage issues in a timely manner.

**Qualifications**

* Registered Nurse (BSN required; MSN preferred); Social Worker (BSW required; MSW and LCSW preferred); or master's in public health or health care administration. If RN: Active, unrestricted RN license to practice in North Carolina.
* At least 5 years of Quality Improvement or relevant health care experience with responsibilities in the following areas: operational leadership, process improvement, project management, systems analysis, data analytics, and team facilitation.
* At least 3 years of supervisory or leadership experience in health care.
* NAHQ Certified Professional in Healthcare Quality (CPHQ)
* Lean / Six Sigma certification a plus.
* Maintain a valid NC driver’s license with current auto liability insurance.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

Excellent communication skills

* - oral, written and public speaking
* Knowledge of government, private sector and community resources
* Knowledge of and compliance with federal and state regulations applicable to the position
* Critical thinking skills, effective clinical judgment, independent decision making, and problem- solving abilities
* Skilled in establishing rapport with providers, community partners, and members
* Strong organizational and time management skills
* Demonstrated leadership skills
* Ability to work independently and function as an integral part of the team
* Expertise with Microsoft Office suite of products and comfort with database software and the internet
* Strong competence in quality improvement methodologies, principles, and recognition programs
* Ability to take “deep dives” into multiple sources of data to drive improvement
* Ability to stimulate innovative thinking & serve as a change agent
* Able to shift strategy or approach in response to the demands of a situation

**Working Conditions**

* Multiple contacts are required with providers, members, health systems and community partners to ensure effectiveness of QI and PS work; exposure to general office conditions, as well as communicable disease could occur.
* Potential for minor physical inconveniences or discomforts in the work setting, including sitting for moderate periods of time.
* Repetitive wrist motion and occasional lifting/carrying of up to 25 pounds.
* Travel required within the region and/or the state.

**Why Join Us:**
----------------

* Make a meaningful impact on youth and families across North Carolina
* Work with a supportive and collaborative care team
* Competitive Benefits Package effective first day of employment
* Opportunities for growth, training, and bonus incentives\*

**Ready to improve the health and quality of life of all North Carolinians by building and supporting better community-based health care delivery systems?**

* **Apply today and join us in delivering compassionate care that makes a difference.**

**Ready to improve the health and quality of life of all North Carolinians by building and supporting better community-based health care delivery systems?**

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Flexible spending account
* Health insurance
* Health savings account
* Life insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Professional development assistance
* Referral program
* Tuition reimbursement
* Vision insurance

records.title: Director Food Safety and Quality
records.description:
Job Summary
 
The Director, Food Safety & Quality is a senior, project-based individual contributor who is deployed to the most critical food safety and quality priorities across Maker’s Pride’s manufacturing network. Rather than leading a team, this leader goes where the need is greatest: stepping into facilities, programs, and issues that require immediate expertise, rapidly assessing the situation, and leading cross-functional teams to resolution without direct authority. Working in close partnership with plant leadership, Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Product Development, Sanitation, and plant FSQA teams, the Director stabilizes high-risk areas, solves complex problems, and builds sustainable capability so improvements hold after the engagement ends. This role serves as a senior technical decision-maker on food safety risk and represents the company with regulators, key customers, and certification bodies on escalated matters.
 
 
Key Responsibilities
 
Critical Site & Program Interventions
 

* Deploy to facilities, lines, and programs identified as highest risk or underperforming, often on short notice, to assess conditions and lead immediate stabilization.
* Rapidly diagnose root causes of food safety and quality gaps and develop clear, prioritized action plans with plant leadership.
* Lead cross-functional plant teams through execution of improvement plans, removing barriers and escalating risks as needed.
* Transition sustainable processes, tools, and ownership to site leadership before exiting each engagement.

Project Leadership & Prioritization
 

* Lead a portfolio of high-impact food safety and quality projects, defining scope, objectives, milestones, and success measures for each.
* Partner with the VP of HSE, FSQA to prioritize engagements based on enterprise risk, business impact, and customer or regulatory exposure.
* Manage multiple concurrent projects across sites, adjusting priorities quickly as new critical issues emerge.
* Provide regular project status, risk updates, and outcomes to the VP of HSE, FSQA and executive leadership.

Food Safety Risk Management & Decision-Making
 

* Serve as a senior technical decision-maker on food safety risk, including product hold, release, and disposition decisions.
* Lead or support the company’s response to food safety incidents, including recall and market withdrawal events, in partnership with senior leadership.
* Lead risk assessments and management of change reviews for high-risk changes to ingredients, processes, equipment, packaging, and facilities.
* Ensure HACCP, HARPC, and Preventive Controls programs at engaged sites are effectively designed, validated, and maintained.

**Technical Expertise:** Allergen Control, Sanitary Design & Complaints
 

* Address high-risk allergen control gaps, including labeling controls, scheduling, segregation, and cleaning validation and verification.
* Provide sanitary design expertise on critical equipment, facility, and capital projects, and ensure food safety requirements are incorporated.
* Lead investigations into significant or recurring customer and consumer complaints, driving root cause analysis and effective CAPA to closure.

External Relationships & Audit Readiness
 

* Represent Maker’s Pride with regulatory agencies, key customers, and certification bodies on escalated food safety matters.
* Lead sites through high-stakes regulatory inspections, customer audits, and GFSI-benchmarked certification audits (e.g., SQF, BRCGS), including remediation of findings.
* Support commercial teams in resolving critical customer quality concerns.

Sustainability & Network Learning
 

* Define success measures for each engagement and verify that improvements are sustained after transition.
* Capture lessons learned and translate solutions into standards, tools, and best practices that can be applied across the network.
* Identify systemic risks across engagements and recommend enterprise-level actions to prevent recurrence.

**Qualifications:** 
**Education:** Bachelor’s degree in Food Science, Engineering, Microbiology, Chemistry, Biological Sciences, or related discipline required.
 
 
**Experience:** 

* 10+ years of experience in food manufacturing, quality, engineering, or food safety required.
* Proven track record leading critical, high-visibility projects or turnarounds across multiple manufacturing sites required.
* Working knowledge of FSMA, HACCP, Preventive Controls, GMPs, and GFSI-benchmarked standards (SQF, BRCGS, or similar) required
* Experience with sanitary design principles and capital project support preferred
* Experience with quality management systems and data analysis tools preferred

**Certifications:** PCQI and/or HACCP certification and Lean Six Sigma Green Belt or equivalent continuous improvement certification preferred
 
 
**Skills:** 

* Strong root cause analysis and data analysis skills, with the ability to quickly assess complex, ambiguous situations and determine what matters most.
* Ability to scope, prioritize, and execute multiple concurrent projects across sites, adjusting quickly as critical issues emerge.
* Builds trust and credibility quickly with plant teams, executives, customers, and regulators to drive results with teams that do not report to them.
* Strong written and verbal communication at all levels, and comfortable shifting between sites, projects, and priorities in a high-travel role.

Work Environment & Physical Demands
 

* 70% travel to manufacturing facilities
* Work in manufacturing environments that may include exposure to noise, varying temperatures, allergens, and moving equipment.
* Ability to stand and walk for extended periods, climb stairs and ladders, and carry light loads.
* Must comply with all GMP, food safety, and safety requirements, including use of required personal protective equipment.

The expectations provided here may also be modified if an employee with a disability could effectively meet the expectations for the role with reasonable accommodation.

Individual base pay depends on work location and additional factors such as experience, job-related skills, and relevant education or training. The position is eligible for a discretionary annual incentive based on company and individual performance. We offer a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, 401k and wellness benefits beginning on the first day of employment.

records.title: General Manager/President – Precision Manufacturing
records.description:
**Company Overview**

American Photonics, a portfolio company of BlueRock Global, is a precision optical manufacturer serving the aerospace, defense, industrial, medical, scientific, and commercial markets.

We are strengthening our manufacturing capabilities, investing in operational improvements, and expanding into higher-value precision optics and infrared applications.

We operate in a technically demanding manufacturing environment where quality, precision, accountability, and reliable execution are essential. Our focus is on building a stronger, more capable manufacturing business positioned for sustainable, profitable growth.

**Job Overview**

American Photonics is seeking an accomplished General Manager to lead overall business performance, manufacturing operations, and organizational development.

This is the senior on-site executive position, with direct responsibility for operating P&L performance and leadership across Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Sales, Supply Chain, and supporting business functions.

The ideal candidate has successfully led a technically complex manufacturing business, improved financial and operational results, developed accountable leadership teams, and executed meaningful business improvements.

We are looking for a decisive, hands-on leader who understands both the financial and operational sides of manufacturing. This individual must be equally comfortable reviewing business performance, resolving production challenges, developing customer relationships, and working directly with employees on the manufacturing floor.

Reporting to ownership, the General Manager will have responsibility for translating strategic objectives into achievable operating plans, establishing clear accountability, and delivering measurable results. The position will work closely with BlueRock's corporate resources while maintaining ownership of day-to-day business execution.

**Duties**

* Assume accountability for operating P&L performance, including revenue, gross margin, EBITDA, operating expenses, working capital, and achievement of financial objectives.
* Develop and execute annual operating plans, budgets, forecasts, workforce plans, and capital investment priorities aligned with business objectives.
* Lead Manufacturing, Engineering, Quality, Sales, Supply Chain, and business operations to ensure coordinated execution and achievement of company objectives.
* Improve manufacturing performance through effective production planning, scheduling, labor utilization, material readiness, equipment effectiveness, and capacity management.
* Identify and resolve operational inefficiencies, production bottlenecks, excess costs, scrap, rework, quality issues, and sources of margin erosion.
* Establish clear departmental objectives, performance metrics, reporting standards, and management accountability for results.
* Strengthen job costing, pricing discipline, inventory control, purchasing practices, and financial visibility to support profitable decision-making.
* Lead and develop department managers, establish clear responsibilities and decision-making authority, address performance gaps, and build a capable, accountable leadership team.
* Partner with Sales and Engineering to evaluate customer opportunities, improve quoting accuracy, assess technical and manufacturing feasibility, and support profitable business growth.
* Build and maintain effective relationships with key customers, suppliers, strategic partners, and other business stakeholders.
* Improve ERP utilization, operational reporting, inventory accuracy, manufacturing documentation, and process controls to support efficient and scalable operations.
* Evaluate manufacturing capabilities, equipment investments, facility requirements, and process improvements based on operational needs, financial returns, and long-term business value.
* Maintain effective quality management systems, product traceability, corrective action processes, workplace safety standards, and compliance with applicable customer and regulatory requirements.
* Provide ownership with timely, accurate reporting on financial performance, operational results, business risks, and progress against established priorities.
* Lead organizational and operational changes with sound judgment, clear communication, and a consistent focus on employee engagement, accountability, and execution.

**Qualifications**

**Required**

* Minimum 10 years of progressive leadership experience in precision, high-tolerance, or technically complex manufacturing environments.
* At least five years in a senior manufacturing leadership role, such as General Manager, Business Unit Leader, President, VP of Operations, or equivalent, with substantial financial and operational accountability.
* Demonstrated responsibility for a manufacturing business or business-unit P&L, including budgets, profitability, cost management, and operating performance.
* Proven success improving manufacturing profitability, productivity, operational efficiency, delivery performance, or organizational effectiveness, supported by measurable results.
* Experience leading cross-functional manufacturing teams, including Operations, Engineering, Quality, Supply Chain, and related business functions.
* Demonstrated ability to develop managers, establish performance expectations, manage organizational change, and hold teams accountable.
* Experience managing manufacturing operations involving complex processes, demanding quality standards, and customer-specific requirements.
* Strong business judgment, financial acumen, and the ability to make timely decisions based on operational and financial information.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Manufacturing, Operations, Business, or a related discipline, or equivalent relevant executive manufacturing experience.
* Ability to work full-time, on-site in Sarasota, Florida.

**Preferred**

* Leadership experience in precision optics, infrared optics, photonics, optical components, precision machining, aerospace, or defense manufacturing.
* Experience improving or scaling a small to mid-sized manufacturing business, particularly within an entrepreneurial or private-equity-backed environment.
* Experience with ERP implementation, systems modernization, manufacturing cost accounting, or operational restructuring.
* Experience leading manufacturing capacity expansion, capital equipment investment, new product introduction, or business improvement initiatives.
* Familiarity with ISO 9001 quality management systems, ITAR/export-control requirements, and regulated manufacturing environments.

**Compensation** will be determined based on the candidate’s relevant experience, qualifications, demonstrated capabilities, and the responsibilities of the position.

**Equal Employment Opportunity**

American Photonics is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to providing a workplace free from discrimination and harassment. All employment decisions are made based on qualifications, experience, performance, and business needs, without regard to any status protected by applicable federal, state, or local laws.

Join us to lead innovative manufacturing processes that make a difference! We value energetic leaders who thrive on strategic growth, operational excellence, and inspiring teams to achieve their best every day.

Pay: From $1.00 per year

Application Question(s):

* Describe your experience leading precision, engineered, regulated, or technically complex manufacturing.
* This is an on-site in-person position, would commute be an issue?
* What is your earliest available start date?
* Describe the most recent manufacturing company you led, including its products, approximate revenue, employee count, and functions reporting to you.
* Describe the scope of your direct P&L responsibility, including the financial results and capital decisions you owned.
* Provide one example of a manufacturing business, market, customer base, or product line you helped grow. What actions did you lead, and what measurable results followed?
* Compensation is based on experience, demonstrated results, and capabilities. What are your salary expectations for this role?

Work Location: In person

records.title: Director, Quality
records.description:
This opportunity is located within our **Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company** business, a global leader of mission-critical hardware and systems solutions including precision energetics systems and innovative explosive solutions.

**Job Description**

**Location:** Simsbury, CT

**Reports to:** VP of Operations

**Industry:** Aerospace & Defense

**Experience Level:** Director (15+ years)

**Shape the Future. Deliver Excellence. Achieve Zero Failure.**

At **Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense (EBAD),** we’ve been innovating for nearly **200 years,** delivering mission-critical technologies that protect lives and advance exploration. As we prepare to double in size over the next 3–5 years, we’re investing in our people and culture to support this transformation.

We’re seeking a dynamic **Director of Quality** to lead a complex, multi-site quality organization and drive performance at scale. Based at our headquarters in Simsbury, Connecticut, this role is critical to ensure the highest levels of product integrity, compliance, and customer trust across a rapidly growing business. This is not just about maintaining standards but about building a future-state vision for quality that enables growth, safeguards mission success, and strengthens EBAD’s reputation as a trusted partner.

**The Opportunity:**

EBAD’s customers depend on us to deliver our products with zero failure in mission-critical environments. The Director of Quality will be responsible for developing and executing a strategic Quality Management System (QMS) while leading quality operations across multiple sites. This leader will be tasked with driving measurable quality improvement, while also championing a culture of accountability, continuous improvement, and operational excellence.

This is an exciting opportunity for a leader to make an immediate impact by providing direction, driving the strategy for the business, and developing a problem-solving culture.

**Core Competencies for Success:**

* **Quality & Compliance Leadership:** Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other high-reliability industries, with expertise in zero-failure mission environments.

* **Continuous Improvement & Performance:** Skilled in EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices with the ability to drive metrics-based improvement and systemic problem-solving.
* **Team Development & Leadership:** Demonstrated ability to coach, mentor, and build strong teams while fostering engagement and accountability.
* **Collaboration & Influence:** Strong cross-functional partnership with credibility to influence senior leadership, customers, and suppliers.
* **Resilience & Adaptability:** Able to manage ambiguity, drive change, and motivate teams in a fast-scaling environment.

**The Candidate We Are Looking For:**

* BS in an engineering discipline (MS preferred)
* Minimum 10 years of experience in high-mix, low-volume operations and manufacturing environment
* Proven success leading complex, multi-site quality organizations in aerospace, defense, or other mission-critical industries
* Demonstrated expertise in leading audits and managing compliance across regulatory bodies, customers, and suppliers, with deep knowledge of standards such as AS9100, ISO9001, and DoD requirements
* Proven ability to enhance customer quality by partnering closely with engineering, operations, and supply chain teams to consistently meet customer demand
* Strong record of measurable quality improvements
* Skilled in continuous improvement, performance metrics, and problem-solving through EBOS, Lean, and Kaizen practices
* Track record of building and developing strong teams, fostering high engagement, and driving accountability

**A Defining Leadership Opportunity:**

* **Legacy:** Join a privately held, 188-year-old business that takes a long-term approach, free from the short-term pressures of quarterly-driven reporting.
* **Impact:** Lead a mission-critical function where zero failure is the standard and success is business-defining.
* **Partnership:** Work directly with the BU President, senior leadership, and enterprise HR leaders in a highly influential role at the intersection of people and business strategy.
* **Culture of Excellence:** Help shape a culture that values people, integrity, and mission-driven excellence, driven by a Kaizen mindset and a commitment to quality and continuous improvement.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**

If you’re a proven quality engineering leader with the vision, discipline, and drive to achieve zero failure in a complex and growing business, this is your opportunity.

**Compensation and Rewards:**

We recognize that world-class leaders deliver world-class impact, and we reward accordingly. This role offers a competitive executive package that includes:

**Base Salary:** $175k – $225k plus annual bonus

**Executive Relocation:** Comprehensive support for a seamless transition

**Additional Enhancements:** Potential sign-on incentives and tailored rewards based on experience

*We offer a competitive compensation package aligned with skills & experience, with flexibility to reward top talent and extraordinary qualifications.*

*Ensign-Bickford Aerospace & Defense Company* *is an Equal Opportunity Employer (EOE). Qualified applicants are considered for employment without regard to race, religion, color, sex, age, disability, sexual orientation, genetic information, national origin, or veteran status.*

records.title: VP, Production - Soft Accessories
records.description:
About Us:

Centric Brands is a leading lifestyle brand collective that designs, sources, markets and sells high quality products in multiple segments, including women’s, men’s and kid’s apparel, accessories, entertainment and beauty. Centric Brands is focused on our customers and our brands that will drive the company’s future growth. We are defined by innovation as we seize new opportunities and thrive in an environment informed by creativity and thinking that is both analytical and outside the box. Centric Brands reflects a team built on respect, for others and for the hard work it takes to achieve our goals and build our bright future together.

**Production**

From sourcing raw materials to manufacturing, order placement, pricing and quality control and getting the finished product where it needs to be, our production team is responsible for ensuring we keep our standards high and our business profitable at every step of the journey. If you are a focused, results -driven, tenacious and highly flexible team player, we’ll give you every opportunity to build a rewarding career with one of the world’s foremost major lifestyle brand collectives.

Specific Responsibilities Would Include:

Centric Brands is looking for a dynamic, creative and resourceful Vice President of Production, Soft Accessories, to join its team. This individual must be a self-starter and collaborative leader who takes initiative, thrives in a fast-paced environment, and is excited to accelerate transformation across Centric Brands. The Vice President of Production, Soft Accessories, oversees all facets of global development, manufacturing and supply chain operations for cold weather accessories, including scarves, gloves, hats, beanies and related knit accessories. This leader will identify and manage the appropriate vendors and factories, negotiate manufacturing orders, and ensure the timely delivery of high-quality, profitable goods.

**ROLES & RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Strategy & Innovation**

 

* Partner with corporate resources to achieve global production efficiencies across divisions and groups
* Lead ongoing market and competitive research to identify innovations in leather, knitwear, yarns, fibers, fabrications, construction, trims and finishing techniques. Translate relevant developments into actionable recommendations for Merchandising and Design, and maintain a current archive of yarns, materials, hardware and production techniques.

**Operations and Results**

* Oversee and continuously evaluate the approved vendor matrix for cold weather accessories, with particular focus on factories with strong technical capabilities in knit scarves, gloves (knit & leather), hats, beanies and related accessories. Review costing, capacity, quality and production standards.
* Lead high-level negotiations on yarn, material, trim and finished-goods pricing to ensure profitability. Approve final buys; oversee production from development samples through final delivery; resolve vendor non-compliance, claims and chargebacks; and coordinate customs classification requirements with Imports.
* Partner with Merchandising, Design and Sales throughout product development to ensure accurate execution of cold weather accessories, including stitch, gauge, yarn, handfeel, fit, construction, color and finishing. Deliver agreed-upon margin goals and development-calendar milestones across the assortment.
* Review production standards and brand consistency across categories and vendors. Oversee quality-control initiatives, including testing and corrective action plans for yarn performance, pilling, shrinkage, colorfastness, seam strength, embellishments, trims and overall product durability.
* Lead high-level troubleshooting of quality and technical issues. Guide special product development and modifications to designs, materials, stitches and constructions while protecting the intended aesthetic, performance and financial goals.
* Oversee capacity planning and vendor performance by sourcing office, region, country and factory. Define accurate costing models; partner with Sales and Planning to project production needs; make yarn and raw-material commitments when appropriate; allocate production; and reserve factory capacity for seasonal peaks.
* any issues

**Customers & Relationships**

* Partner with customers, Sales, Merchandising and Operations, as well as vendors and factories to ensure adequate flow of goods relative to orders and anticipated demand criteria
* Oversee interoffice communication and follow-up with internal and external customers and contacts regarding production, including suppliers and vendors
* Delegate special projects as assigned
* Travel regularly to factories and international trade shows

**Leadership & Teams**

* Lead, train and motivate global team of full-time and part-time personnel as well as factory and independent agents; strategize staffing needs across categories and brands, where appropriate
* Contribute positively to team dynamic and manage up where necessary
* Attract, develop and retain talent; create appropriate succession plans
* Monitor and evaluate performance of individuals and team(s)

Our Best Fit Candidate Would Have:

* Superior organizational skills and excellent communication skills; team oriented
* Ability to multi-task and meet deadlines, highly detail oriented and meticulous
* Creativity, technical capability and sensibility for merchandising/design
* Required hands-on production and sourcing experience in cold weather accessories, including scarves, gloves (knit & leather), hats, beanies and related knit accessories.
* Bachelor’s Degree
* 10+ years’ experience in production and sourcing; significant relevant experience in category
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, Adobe products, SAP, CAD and Mac computers

Salary Range: $200,000 - $240,000

At Centric Brands, we believe our people are our greatest asset, and we seek to structure competitive compensation offers to ensure that we are able to attract and retain the best talent. Our job postings include an annual base salary range at the time of employment. The stated base salary range represents our good faith estimate as to what candidates are likely to expect, and we tailor our offers within the range based on several factors, including the selected candidate's educational and professional experience, industry knowledge, location, technical and communication skills, and other factors that may prove relevant during the selection process. Base salary is a part of a total compensation package, which, depending on the position, may also include commission earnings, annual bonus and other Centric Brands sponsored benefit programs.

**Be part of our growing community by getting involved with groups, teams and initiatives like Be Green, Be Giving, and Be Celebrated.**

**Centric Brands is an Equal Opportunity Employer**

Please note that Centric Brands will only reach out to interview, make an offer of employment or conduct onboarding activities for candidates who have applied through our careers site. When interviewing for a position, the candidate experience will include live interaction, such as a video conference or telephone call, with a Recruiter and/or company employee(s). We will never ask for any money or payments from applicants at any point in the recruitment process. Be aware of suspicious recruitment activity. If you think you are a victim of an employment scam, you may contact your local law enforcement agency and/or visit the Federal Trade Commission website here: https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/job-scams.
