records.description:
**About CAMP Systems:**
At CAMP Systems, we are the trusted leader in aircraft compliance and health management, proudly serving the global business aviation industry. With over 20,000 aircraft and 33,000 engines supported on our cutting-edge platforms, and partnerships with more than 1,300 maintenance facilities and parts suppliers worldwide, we’re shaping the future of aviation technology. Since our founding in 1968, we’ve grown to a dynamic team of 1,600+ employees across 14 locations globally—all united by a passion for innovation and excellence.

**Our Mission & Vision:**
We connect the aviation industry through smart technology to make flight safer and more efficient, driving the future of aviation with intelligence and exceptional customer experiences.

**Our Values & Excellence Mindset:**
We are customer obsessed, trust-driven, owners of our work, stronger together, constantly curious, and boldly innovative.

**What You Will Experience in This Role:**

The Director - Quality Assurance drives quality across CAMP's Aircraft Health Management business and provides quality oversight for data and process quality concerns. The role owns the QMS, the internal audit program, and the full quality escape lifecycle, and serves as CAMP's quality voice with OEMs, regulators, and key customers. The right candidate combines deep aviation maintenance knowledge with a disciplined, data-driven approach to compliance and continuous improvement.

This is a high-visibility leadership role reporting to the Vice President, Aviation Health Management Operations. The Director partners with senior leaders across a global organization and will build on an established quality program: strengthening the QMS, deepening OEM and customer confidence, and scaling quality practices as AHM grows.

**Responsibilities:**

**Strategy & Leadership**

* Own and lead quality strategy across the full Aircraft Health Management organization, spanning maintenance tracking and engine health monitoring services, aligned with CAMP's business objectives.
* Serve as the escalation point for quality complaints from customer-facing, maintenance compliance, engine health monitoring, flight scheduling, and inventory functions.
* Partner with senior management and departmental leaders to embed quality methodologies across the organization and lead the associated change management.
* Own the quality budget, resource plan, and tooling (QMS, audit, and corrective action platforms), and build the succession pipeline for the quality team.

**Quality Management System & Certification**

* Own the Quality Management System (QMS) and quality SOPs, driving continuous improvement and ensuring processes meet strict regulatory and OEM requirements.
* Maintain ISO 9001 (or higher) certification for the engine health monitoring business, serving as external certification audit lead and ensuring ongoing audit readiness.
* Lead QMS management review with executive leadership, setting risk-based quality objectives and ensuring consistent QMS implementation (document control, competency records, data integrity) across all AHM locations in North America, Europe, and India.

**Audit & Compliance**

* Own the internal audit program end to end, including audit planning, execution, reporting, and the selection, training, and management of internal auditors.
* Host and manage OEM, customer, and third-party audits, driving findings to timely closure.

**Quality Escapes & Corrective Action**

* Manage all quality escapes from intake through investigation, root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, and verification of effectiveness, with clear accountability to customers and OEM partners.
* Define and report corrective action performance metrics (e.g., escape rate, time to containment, on-time closure, recurrence) with clear thresholds and escalation paths.

**OEM & Customer Engagement**

* Facilitate and chair weekly, monthly, and quarterly strategic OEM meetings covering quality trends, KPI compliance, and corrective action status.
* Serve as primary quality liaison to OEM partners, regulatory bodies, and high-profile customers and large fleet operators under significant OEM contracts.
* Facilitate weekly, monthly, and quarterly quality reviews with senior management and functional leaders, translating escape, audit, and customer feedback data into trends and strategic quality initiatives.

**Continuous Improvement & Team Leadership**

* Lead process improvement using Lean Six Sigma methods, mentoring teams and driving measurable reductions in escapes, rework, and risk.
* Maintain an executive quality scorecard (customer feedback, escapes, audit results, corrective action performance) to drive data-based decisions.
* Lead, mentor, and develop a team of four, setting priorities and fostering a culture of excellence, accountability, and collaboration.
* Partner with AHM operations, training, and product leaders to ensure analyst competency, training effectiveness, and quality readiness for new products, processes, and teams.

**You have:**

* Bachelor's degree in Aerospace, Engineering, Quality Management, or a related field; advanced degree a plus.
* Minimum of 10 years of proven leadership experience in the aviation or aerospace sector, with senior quality assurance experience preferred.
* Strong working knowledge of aviation maintenance and its regulatory requirements (FAA, EASA, and OEM requirements). Hands-on aviation maintenance experience may offset formal credentials.
* Experience managing quality escapes, investigations, root cause analysis, and corrective action programs.
* Experience owning or managing a QMS in a regulated environment, with working knowledge of ISO 9001 (AS9100 familiarity a plus).
* Strong analytical skills, with the ability to turn quality data into executive-level metrics, insights, and recommendations.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to build relationships with OEMs, customers, and leaders at all levels of the organization.
* Strategic thinking with a strong focus on results and the ability to manage complex projects and initiatives.
* Ability to lead across a multi-site, multi-region team; willingness to travel to CAMP offices, OEM, and customer sites as needed.

**Nice to have:**

* Certified ISO 9001 Internal/External Auditor (or equivalent lead auditor certification) with hands-on audit experience.
* Six Sigma Black Belt, with demonstrated process improvement results.
* Quality manager certification (e.g., ASQ CQM) or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) is a bonus.
* Experience working with large OEM contracts and high-profile customers or large fleet operators.
* Experience in aircraft maintenance tracking, engine trend monitoring, or other SaaS/data-driven service environments.

**Why Work at CAMP?**

Join a culture where your ideas matter, your impact is real, and your growth is supported. Be part of a team reimagining the future of aviation.

CAMP is committed to creating a diverse environment and is proud to be an affirmative action and equal opportunity employer - vets/disabled

CAMP is committed to providing access, equal opportunity, and reasonable accommodation for individuals with disabilities in employment, its services, programs, and activities. To request reasonable accommodation, please contact hr@campsystems.com.

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, national origin, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, disability or protected veteran status EEO.

Equal Opportunity Employer
  
  
This employer is required to notify all applicants of their rights pursuant to federal employment laws.
  
For further information, please review the Know Your Rights notice from the Department of Labor.

records.description:
**Description**
The
**Director of Quality & Compliance**
is responsible for leading LOPA’s overall quality strategy, overseeing the agency’s Quality Management System (QMS) and ensuring that all products, services, and internal processes meet or exceed internal and external customer expectations and regulatory standards. Reporting to the Chief Strategy Officer, the position partners with operational leaders to translate requirements and quality findings into effective, measurable practices, fostering an agency-wide culture of integrity and operational excellence.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**
**Quality Strategy & QMS Governance**

* Quality Management System. Own, maintain, and continuously improve the agency-wide QMS aligning objectives with organizational priorities and applicable standards.
* Program Implementation. Lead implementation and standardization of quality initiatives, establish milestones and accountabilities, monitor adoption, and assess ongoing effectiveness and sustainability.
* Policies. Oversee agency-wide development, implementation, including version control, approval workflows for all controlled documents. Support operational owners on content development and enforcement of policies and procedures.

**Regulatory Compliance & Audits**

* Compliance Oversight. Monitor compliance with applicable CMS requirements, OPTN policies and FDA regulations and other relevant industry standards and local and federal government regulations.
* Audit Readiness and Management. Oversee internal quality audits of donation and business processes to ensure regulatory and policy compliance, leveraging operational data to advise internal stakeholders on corrective actions; ensure ongoing monitoring of implemented changes to assess long-term effectiveness and sustainability. Serve as the primary liaison during external regulatory inspections and customer audits. Oversee agency’s response to any findings or observations from external audit.
* Quality records. Ensure quality records and compliance documentation are accurate, controlled, retrievable and inspection ready.

**Continuous Improvement & CAPA**

* Root-Cause Analysis. Oversees LOPA’s Occurrence Management Program to investigate instances of procedural non-conformance, resolve systemic issues, and prevent recurrence.
* Data and KPIs. Establish quality metrics, track key performance indicators (KPIs), and analyze statistical trends to identify efficiency gains within the QMS.
* Support Process Optimization. Partner with Operations leadership and the Performance Excellence team to embed quality and drive excellence in all process improvement initiatives.

**Leadership & Supplier Management**

* Team Development. Recruit, coach develop and evaluate a team of auditors and quality team members by setting priorities and performance expectations.
* Supplier Quality. Oversee vendor qualification, auditing, and performance monitoring to ensure specifications are met.
* Customer Relations. Collaborate directly with customers to resolve quality complaints, review technical specifications, and improve satisfaction.
* Escalation: Promptly communicates significant quality or regulatory concerns to CSO and recommend protective or corrective measures.

**Requirements**
**Degree.**
Bachelor’s degree in Quality Management, Life Sciences, Public Health, Business, or a related field. Master’s degree preferred.
  
  
**Experience.**
Minimum of five (5) years of progressive experience in quality management, assurance and/or control, regulatory compliance, auditing or related functions within a highly regulated environment, including at least two (2) years of supervisor, management or demonstrated functional leadership experience.
  
  
**Implementation Experience.**
Demonstrated experience implementing, managing or enhancing quality management systems, regulatory compliance programs, or organization quality initiatives required.
  
  
**Industry Background.**
Proven track record of applying knowledge of the principles of quality assurance/quality control. Experience within healthcare or donation and transplantation preferred.
  
  
**Skills & Certifications.**
Certified Quality Manager (ASQ CMQ/OE), Six Sigma Black Belt, or Certified Quality Auditor (CQA) strongly preferred.
  
  
**Technical Expertise.**
Deep working knowledge of senior leadership of a Quality System. Experience applying CMS, OPTN, and FDA standards and regulations preferred.
  
  
**Leadership.**
Exceptional cross-functional communication, strong decision making and problem-solving capabilities; analytical thinker with keen ability to resolve conflict and influence executive stakeholders, adept at managing agency-wide change.

records.title: Quality Director
records.description:
As the
**Director of Quality**
, you will lead the quality strategy and continuous improvement efforts across all Bison manufacturing sites. You will be responsible for ensuring that the products meet or exceed customer expectations, industry standards, and regulatory requirements while driving overall quality performance and fostering a culture of continuous improvement. You will work closely with cross-functional teams to establish and maintain effective quality systems, drive process improvements, and ensure compliance with industry certifications.
  
  
This position can be based at either our
**Whitsett, NC**
or
**Reynosa, MX**
facility.
  
  
**What You Will Do**
  
  

* Leadership & Strategy

+ Develop and execute a strategic quality plan in alignment with business unit goals.
+ Lead, mentor, and develop a team of quality professionals across two locations, ensuring consistency in processes and objectives.
+ Champion a culture of quality, accountability, and continuous improvement.

* Quality Management Systems (QMS)

+ Oversee the implementation, maintenance, and improvement of the QAD Elements QMS and other relevant Quality Management Systems at both locations. Ensure compliance with customer, regulatory, and industry-specific quality standards (e.g., FDA, ISO, AS9100, etc.).
+ Monitor and evaluate the effectiveness of quality management systems and propose enhancements to improve overall performance.

* Process & Product Quality

+ Collaborate with sales, operations, engineering, and supply chain teams to identify drive resolution of quality issues, ensuring process and product integrity.
+ Support root cause analysis and drive corrective and preventive actions (CAPA) for internal and external quality issues.
+ Oversee first article inspections, process capability studies, and validation/qualification activities to ensure robust manufacturing processes.

* Continuous Improvement

+ Lead Lean Six Sigma or other continuous improvement initiatives aimed at reducing defects, enhancing efficiency, and improving overall quality.
+ Implement data-driven decision-making tools (e.g., SPC, FMEA, Control Plans) to monitor and improve process capabilities.
+ Facilitate cross-functional value stream mapping sessions and quality workshops to drive process improvements.

* Customer & Supplier Relations

+ Serve as the main point of contact for customer quality issues, audits, and feedback, ensuring timely and effective resolution.

****Position Summary****
The Senior Manager, Manufacturing provides strategic and operational leadership for manufacturing execution, workforce planning, quality, cost, delivery, and continuous improvement. This role translates demand and customer requirements into executable production plans, leads manufacturing teams, and partners across Supply Chain, Quality, Engineering, Program Management, and Human Resources to deliver safe, efficient, scalable, and high-quality operations.
  
  
****Hyve Company Overview****
Hyve Solutions transforms complex engineering challenges into production reality for technology innovators building AI, cloud, and connected infrastructure. As a US-based manufacturing partner, the company rapidly delivers fast, agile execution through deep technical partnerships and co-innovation, and supply chain clarity. Hyve's integrated ODM, CM, and SI capabilities eliminate vendor complexity while accelerating time-to-market with single-partner accountability from design through scale. The company co-innovates with deep engineering expertise, treating customer success as its own while building tomorrow's digital infrastructure.

. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, qualifications, and business needs

**About Analog Devices**
Analog Devices, Inc. (NASDAQ: ADI ) is a global semiconductor leader that bridges the physical and digital worlds to enable breakthroughs at the Intelligent Edge. ADI combines analog, digital, and software technologies into solutions that help drive advancements in digitized factories, mobility, and digital healthcare, combat climate change, and reliably connect humans and the world. With revenue of more than $9 billion in FY24 and approximately 24,000 people globally, ADI ensures today's innovators stay Ahead of What's Possible™. Learn more at www.analog.com and on LinkedIn and Twitter (X).
  
  
**Senior Manager, Production – Fab Operations**
The Camas Wafer Fab is a growing 150mm, high‑volume, 24x7 manufacturing facility producing leading‑edge precision ICs in support of ADI’s diversified semiconductor business.
  
  
Reporting to the Wafer Fab General Manager, the
**Senior Manager, Production – Fab Operations**
will lead our ~300‑employee Production organization—including Production Managers, Supervisors, Trainers, 5S & Continuous Improvement, New Product Technicians, Leads, and Operators—who execute day‑to‑day manufacturing, testing, and shipping of a broad product portfolio as the fab continues to ramp, expand, and modernize a facility with over 25 years of operational history.
  
  
Apply now for the opportunity to grow your career and help innovate ahead of what’s possible.
  
  
**Job Duties**
The Senior Manager, Production – Fab Operations is a senior operations leader responsible for translating site strategy into strong operational execution. Responsibilities are aligned to three core competency areas:
  
  
**Operational & Strategic Execution**

* Translate site and enterprise manufacturing strategies into actionable operational plans for the Production organization, aligned with objectives for safety, quality, productivity, cost, talent development, and sustainability.
* Lead the execution of production improvement roadmaps, supporting longer‑term digital transformation, automation, and modernization initiatives defined at the site level.
* Drive adoption of data‑driven and AI‑enabled decision making within production operations, leveraging analytics, automation, and machine‑learning‑based insights to improve daily execution and performance stability.
* Support change management efforts associated with new technologies, digital tools, demand shifts, and new product introductions, ensuring disciplined adoption on the production floor.
* Share and apply best‑known methods from across ADI’s manufacturing network to continuously elevate production performance.

**Operational Excellence**

* Maintain a safe and healthy work environment by enforcing organizational standards, adhering to 5S principles, and complying with ADI policies, legal requirements, and regulatory standards.
* Own day‑to‑day production quality performance, applying a zero‑defect mindset using traditional quality methodologies (8D, 5‑Why, SPC) and AI‑assisted defect detection, yield analysis, and trend identification.
* Lead execution of production plans that deliver short‑term tactical results while driving continuous improvement across Safety, Quality, Productivity, Cost, and Efficiency metrics.
* Utilize predictive and prescriptive analytics, where applicable, to anticipate equipment issues, process drift, capacity constraints, and safety risks before they impact performance.
* Provide clear tactical direction through written reports, dashboards, presentations, daily operational reviews, all‑hands meetings, and shift‑level stand‑ups, ensuring decisions are grounded in accurate, timely data.
* Lead capacity modeling, scenario analysis, and demand response activities within the production organization, partnering with site leadership on longer‑range planning.
* Partner closely with Supply Chain to optimize wafer starts, cycle time, and scheduling, balancing customer demand with fab constraints and operational risk.
* Participate in internal and external audits to ensure compliance, business continuity, and continuous improvement, including adherence to ADI’s responsible and ethical use of AI in manufacturing operations.
* Support the development and ramp of new products and non‑standard fabrication requirements while maintaining safe, stable, and predictable production output.
* Ensure effective cross‑training programs and skills matrices are in place, leveraging digital tools to improve workforce flexibility and readiness.

**Effective Team Leadership**

* Lead recruiting, hiring, onboarding, and training efforts for the Production organization, aligning staffing plans with quarterly and longer‑range production needs.
* Foster a culture of engagement, accountability, and continuous improvement through proactive communication, coaching, and visible leadership presence across all shifts.
* Develop production supervisors and frontline leaders capable of operating in an increasingly digital, automated, and data‑driven manufacturing environment.
* Execute effective performance management processes to improve team continuity, leadership capability, and operational results.
* Partner with Human Resources to support competency development, technical capability building, and training plans aligned with future manufacturing needs.
* Ensure alignment with ADI Enterprise Excellence Guiding Principles, emphasizing safety, quality, operational rigor, and responsible innovation.

**SCHEDULE**
This is an exempt role, working on‑site in Camas, Washington, primarily Monday through Friday, supporting a 24x7 continuous operation.
  
  
Occasional night or weekend hours are required to support operational needs.
  
  
**Minimum Qualifications**

* Bachelor’s degree in Business, Engineering, or a related field required; technical or engineering degree strongly preferred.
* 8+ years of leadership experience in high‑volume wafer fabrication or advanced manufacturing operations.
* Demonstrated success leading large production teams through supervisors and frontline leaders.
* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with proven effectiveness in a data‑driven, metrics‑based operating environment.
* Solid working knowledge of manufacturing and business systems (ERP/MRP, MES, dispatching, capacity planning, Microsoft Office).
* Demonstrated ability to apply analytics, digital tools, and emerging AI/ML capabilities to improve safety, quality, productivity, and cost performance.
* Strong problem‑solving skills, operational discipline, and passion for continuous improvement.

**About Us**
Spellman High Voltage Electronics Corporation, a family owned business for over 75 years, takes pride in powering progress in health, security and quality of life. We are key partners with the world’s leading medical devices, semiconductor, scientific analytics and industrial systems manufacturers. When they want to push the limits of what’s possible with high voltage applications, they turn to us to make it happen.
  
  
While Spellman is not a household name, our products are used to make and often power many of the most advanced technologies that make modern life possible. With design and manufacturing sites in North America, Europe and Asia, we have become the preferred provider of high voltage power solutions for OEMs pushing the boundaries of technology around the world by designing and producing the products they need to power progress.
  
  
The primary role of the Senior Manager, NPI will provide leadership to a diverse team of engineers and provide support in the design, documentation, analysis, and coordination of release for products being transferred from design to production. The Senior Manager, NPI will contribute to the success of projects as well as the team. In this role, the Senior Manager, NPI will balance the work within the team, coach the team through technical challenges, and act as a role model in the organization. The Senior Manager, NPI will be expected to provide technical input to the leadership team to support business decisions.
  
  
This leader, with their team develops and implements operations requirements for design transfer across all product portfolios and collaborates with development, manufacturing and technical support teams to assure that all aspects of design for quality and manufacturability (DQM) are utilized for robust design development, transfer and ultimately scale up. Assures appropriate test method validations and product specifications are developed and implemented. Individual is also responsible for managing new part number creation and appropriate work instruction development. Will work cross functionally to ensure repeatability and reproducibility of the manufactured products within product and process capabilities and meeting of desired specifications.

records.title: Director of Continuous Improvement
records.description:
Restek is looking for a builder. As our Director of Continuous Improvement, you’ll stand up an enterprise-wide continuous improvement program, developing the systems, the talent, and the Lean culture that make operational excellence part of how we work every day across Manufacturing, Quality, Supply Chain, Engineering, and Customer Experience.

Reporting to the Vice President of Operations, you’ll be our principal change agent, leading everything from multi-year transformation programs to focused Kaizen events. Your work will directly shape our strategic priorities by reducing waste and scrap, raising quality, speeding flow, improving the customer experience, and growing profitability.

**What You’ll Do**

Set the Strategy

* Own the multi-year CI roadmap, aligned with Restek’s strategic plan, annual operating plan, and Operations priorities.
* Establish the management system that makes improvement stick (daily management, tiered huddles, A3 problem solving) and define a CI maturity model to guide each function’s progress.
* Partner with Finance to validate savings and ensure improvement gains show up in the P&L.

Lead the Work

* Personally lead and facilitate high-impact Kaizen events, Value Stream Mapping, and transformation projects tied to safety, quality, delivery, cost, inventory, and customer outcomes.
* Drive measurable gains in OEE, first-pass yield, scrap and rework, on-time delivery, lead time, inventory turns, customer response time, and total cost of quality.
* Make sure improvement work is well scoped, resourced, and sustained, and bring the best practices from inside and outside Restek to every team.

Make an Impact Across the Business

* **Manufacturing:**
  Improve safety, quality, throughput, changeover, and productivity through standard work, visual management, and a Lean production system.
* **Customer Experience:**
  Help deliver an industry-leading experience through faster response and resolution, better processes, and digital enablement.
* **Supply Chain:**
  Strengthen supplier quality and delivery, optimize inventory, and streamline order-to-cash, delivering measurable cost savings.
* **Engineering:**
  Partner on design for manufacturability, new product introduction, and change management to speed time-to-market and build it right the first time.

Build Capability and Culture

* Build, lead, and develop the Continuous Improvement team.
* Design and deliver Restek’s CI training curriculum, including Lean fundamentals, Yellow/Green/Black Belt paths, problem-solving methods, and leader standard work.
* Coach senior leaders and frontline managers in CI thinking, and develop change agents at every level to scale CI beyond the central team.
* Put the metrics and dashboards in place that make progress visible from the manufacturing floor to the executive team, and share wins and learnings across the organization.

**How We Lead at Restek**

Restek leaders model our core values and act as stewards of our culture. They communicate openly, build trust, and support the growth and well-being of their teams. They think globally and act locally, create clarity around goals, hold themselves accountable, partner across functions and regions, and lead with humility and service so every employee-owner can contribute to Restek’s success.

**What You Bring**

**Qualifications:**

The typical requirements for this role include a bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Operations Management, Business Administration (master's degree, preferred), or a related field, plus 10 years of progressive operations and CI experience, including at least 5 years in a senior CI or operational excellence leadership role in manufacturing, or the equivalent combination of education and experience.

**Additional Skills & Abilities:**

* A proven track record of leading enterprise-level Lean transformations with sustained, financially validated results.
* Lean Six Sigma Black Belt certification (Master Black Belt certification is preferred)
* Hands-on experience across multiple functions (manufacturing, supply chain, quality, customer service, and/or engineering), with credibility on the manufacturing floor and with leadership.
* Experience leading and developing CI practitioners and managers.
* Deep fluency in the CI toolkit: Lean (5S, standard work, visual management, flow, pull, SMED, TPM, Kaizen), Six Sigma (DMAIC, SPC, DOE), Value Stream Mapping, Hoshin Kanri, and structured problem solving (A3, 8D, 5-Why, fishbone).
* Advanced Excel and Power BI (or equivalent) skills for data-driven decision making.
* A servant-leader and coach who thinks strategically, executes in detail, and influences from the manufacturing floor to the Leadership Team, with outstanding written, verbal, and executive presentation skills.

Experience in a regulated manufacturing environment (e.g., FDA, ISO 9001, ISO 13485, GMP) or in scientific instruments, life sciences, chromatography, analytical, or precision-manufactured products and experience bringing digital tools and analytics (e.g., MES, ERP, Power BI, advanced analytics) into the CI toolkit is preferred.

This full onsite position will require the successful completion of a standard background check in accordance with Restek policy. Employment with Restek will require successful completion of a pre-employment drug screen.

**What Makes Restek Unique**

We prioritize work-life balance and well-being with offerings like generous PTO, unlimited sick time, onsite fitness center and wellness program with incentives, childcare reimbursement, and adoption assistance—giving you the tools to Own Your Well-Being. Through our Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP) and robust 8% retirement contributions, you can Own Your Financial Future while sharing in the success you help create. Our commitment to development ensures you can Own Your Growth through learning opportunities, career advancement programs, and a collaborative culture that values innovation and teamwork.

At Restek, our core values—We Care, Better Every Day, Respect for All, and Win Together—are at the heart of everything we do. We care deeply about our employee-owners, our customers, and the communities we serve around the world. We strive to be better every day by fostering personal and professional growth while delivering solutions that drive positive global change. We value respect for all, creating a workplace where every voice matters and diverse perspectives drive innovation. And we believe we win together, celebrating shared success as a 100% employee-owned company.

We are an equal opportunity employer, considering applicants without regard to race, ethnicity, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, disability, religion, military or veteran status, or any other protected characteristic. Restek provides reasonable accommodations for individuals with disabilities in accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act and applicable laws.

If you’re ready to join a team that lives its values and empowers you to Own Your Future, we’d love to hear your story. Apply today.

Join the Cedar Crest leadership team as the Director of Quality! Situated on over 30 acres in the beautiful rolling hills of Central Texas, Cedar Crest provides innovative behavioral health and substance abuse treatment for children, adolescents, and adults. Our private campus includes walking trails, picnic areas, outdoor swimming pool, full-size gym, and state-of-the-art exercise equipment; providing opportunities for leisure, therapeutic recreation, and team building skills. We are seeking a dynamic and experienced Director of Quality and Accreditation to lead our facility’s efforts in ensuring the highest standards of patient care and safety. This leadership role is responsible for overseeing regulatory compliance, quality assurance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives across all clinical and operational areas. The Director will guide the development and implementation of quality protocols, manage accreditation processes, and lead the Quality Assurance and Process Improvement (QAPI) program. The ideal candidate will be a proactive, strategic thinker with a strong commitment to achieving excellence in care delivery and regulatory readiness.

**PURPOSE STATEMENT:**

The Director of Quality and Accreditation is responsible for ensuring patient safety and superior quality of care as measured by survey readiness, treatment program fidelity, and compliance with state and federal laws and regulations and accreditation standards. As such, the Director is responsible for leading and overseeing all aspects of policy development; comprehensive implementation of Acadia’s prescribed clinical protocols, operational quality oversight standards, and programmatic expectations; critical incident reporting; regulatory engagement, including development and submission of plans of correction; certification achievement and maintenance; oversight of the quality assurance and process improvement (QAPI) program; and on-going regulatory readiness strategies at the facility. Through routine physical presence in patient care areas, data analysis and documentation monitoring, and intentional sharing of deep subject-matter expertise, the Director will ensure a proactive, multidisciplinary focus on quality and excellence within the facility.

Responsibilities:

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Lead and monitor day-to-day regulatory readiness, patient safety, and service excellence across the facility.
* QAPI program oversight and management – follow and develop processes for identification, collection, and analysis of quality performance data.

  + Conduct annual preparation and evaluation of the facility QAPI Program.

  + Facility-wide support – collaborate with other departments to sustainably implement best-practices in regulatory/accreditation compliance as evidenced by measurable results with regard to survey outcomes, patient safety metrics, patient experience results, HBIPS, etc.
  + Develop and maintain proficiency in regulatory planning strategy for all standards for all relevant regulatory and accrediting bodies at the local, state, and federal level.
  + Develop and maintain proficiency in the functionality and auditing within electronic platforms such as electronic patient observations and the electronic medical record, as applicable.
  + Lead Root-Cause Analyses and conduct timely and regular evaluation of serious incidents, complaints, grievances and related investigations to:
    - Identification of events, trends and patterns that may affect client health, safety and or treatment efficacy,
    - Committee evaluation findings and recommendations submitted to agency management for corrective action,
    - Implemented actions, outcomes, trends analyzed over time
  + Develop corrective action plans for the resolution of areas of regulatory vulnerability or those which could compromise patient safety in collaboration with other facility leaders.
  + Ensure proper reporting of violations or potential violations to duly authorized enforcement agencies as appropriate and/or required.
  + Ensure proper reporting of incidents and adverse clinical outcomes to duly authorized enforcement agencies or regulatory agencies as appropriate and/or required.
  + In conjunction with assigned corporate Division Quality Director, initiate and lead communications with regulatory agencies as appropriate.
  + Develop sustainable performance improvement practices through analysis of data and prioritization of efforts to improve survey readiness and consistency of care delivery using expected best-practices.
  + Ensure multidisciplinary ownership of best-practices in self-monitoring, auditing, and process improvement, escalating opportunities for improved engagement to the facility CEO as appropriate.
  + Ensures strategic and operational implementation of regulatory requirements, guidelines, and standards of federal, state, and local licensing agencies, accrediting and certifying organizations.
  + Collaborates with Division and Corporate entities and external parties to ensure strategic quality and patient safety initiatives are fully executed at the facility level. Facilitates effective communication with facility and division leadership regarding key clinical performance improvement activities and initiatives.
  + Serves as a technical advisor, educator and internal consultant to all hospital management, staff, and physicians on the use of performance improvement tools and techniques, analytical techniques, and statistical applications.
  + Ensure facility compliance with policies and applicable standards as required by regulatory/accrediting bodies.
  + Facility leader and subject matter expert on high reliability principles and strategies to achieve zero harm.

* Clinical program excellence – assess fidelity and identify root-causes for gaps/lapses in fidelity to Acadia standards. Support other departments in developing and implementing remediation and improvement plans to achieve fidelity to Acadia’s expected practices, including all elements of treatment program implementation.
* + Develop, review, and educate on internal clinical procedures and appropriate use of outcome evaluation tools and the associated results – including patient experience data and other quality scorecard metrics – to ensure continuous quality improvement and ongoing compliance with federal, state, and third-party regulatory requirements.
  + Translate standards, requirements, and policies into terms or processes meaningful to the facility.

records.description:
Direct Biologics is a market leading innovator and science-based cGMP manufacturer of regenerative biologic products. Direct Biologics is hiring a hands-on QC leader for our Poway, CA testing laboratory in the greater San Diego area. You will lead a team of analysts to execute release and stability testing for a late-stage extracellular vesicle biologics program as part of a broader multi-product pipeline, and prepare the QC function for commercial operations.

We are currently looking for a Director of QC, responsible for:

* Responsible for strategy and execution of late-stage to commercial cGMP testing laboratory readiness, owning key decisions in method transfer, validation, and life-cycle management.
* Drives phase-appropriate regulatory and compliance initiatives for a portfolio of cell therapy extracellular vesicle products (early clinical through commercial stages). Presents plans to senior leadership and leads QC workstream for inspection readiness.
* Leads interactions with health authorities related to internal and outsource testing programs, including in-process, characterization, drug substance and drug product release, and stability.
* This working leadership position requires hands-on participation in routine and non-routine testing activities. The individual must maintain their own training and qualification, work independently at the laboratory bench, execute test methods, troubleshoot problems, perform investigations, and write reports when needed to meet business and regulatory commitments.
* Collaborates with R&D and Analytical Development team to introduce method lifecycle improvements and new technologies to the QC laboratory.
* Accountable for timely execution and documentation of routine laboratory tests. Ensures the on-time closure of sampling plans, protocols, laboratory investigations, CAPAs, change control records, and other QMS commitments.
* Develops and communicates departmental resourcing plans to serve broad company goals, including personnel, budget, and timelines. Adjusts plans and priorities according to executive leadership resourcing decisions.
* Leads Quality Control operations:
* + Hire, onboard, train, qualify, and assist professional development of QC team members.
* + Ensure timely execution of STAT and release testing.
* + Manage stability sample inventory and pull schedule, coordinating sample transit with cGMP warehouse, outsource sample submission, and timely internal testing.
* + Ensure timely purchase and qualification of supplies, materials, and equipment.
* + Maintain equipment use, calibration, maintenance, and cleaning records and coordinate related activities.
* + Communicate testing timeframes, expected start/finish dates, and testing outcomes to internal and external stakeholders.
* + Author/approve policies, procedures, and work instructions for accuracy and compliance.
* + Author/approve ROA, COA, trend reports, and stability reports.
* Responsible for QC data/records to ensure content adheres to established cGMP quality standards.
* + Maintain risk register, support internal and mock audits, and show steady compliance progress in collaboration with QA team members.
* + Collaborate with IT to ensure data Integrity and storage of original source data in accordance with part 11 requirements.
* Ensure strict adherence to EPA, OSHA, and FAA safety and clean environmental guidelines.
* Occasional travel by air and/or car may be required to participate in on-site vendor activities, such as method transfer, vendor meetings, and vendor quality audits.
* Excels in a fast-paced environment. Independently prioritizes activity based on importance and urgency, manages time well, anticipates challenges, and delivers progress in line with program goals.
* Strong attention to detail and related understanding of CFR, compendial, and other regulatory requirements.

  
  
**Requirements**

**Skill Requirements:**

* Top expert in preparing cGMP clinical stage testing laboratories for commercial launch, with evidence of leading a QC readiness workstream for a late-stage or commercial biologic product.
* Extensive knowledge of domestic and global compliance requirements for commercial release testing programs.
* Recent hands-on experience with one or more of the following: human cell culture techniques, cell-based potency assays, protein assays (plate based ELISAs, immunostaining-based assays, fluorescence microscopy), quantitative PCR, RNA and protein isolation and quantification methods.
* Familiarity with cGMP Quality Control testing, qualification, and validation of analytical test methods with internal and outsourced contexts.
* Strong verbal and written communication skills in cross-functional team setting.
* Must be highly flexible to respond to urgent needs and directional changes in a start-up environment but also have the attention to detail required to execute studies that will be reviewed by the FDA and other regulatory authorities.
* Lead GMP QC investigations and provide solutions to issues including OOS, deviations and/or CAPA.
* Ability to maintain lab equipment including qualification and calibration.
* Knowledgeable about statistical modeling for quality control applications.
* Technical understanding and working knowledge of contemporary molecular biology, cell biology, microbiology and/or biochemistry.
* Track record leading efficient and cost-effective QC operations while maintaining scientific rigor and GMP compliance. Demonstrated ability to optimize resources, streamline processes, and overcome challenges in a lean operating model.

**Qualifications Requirements:**

* Advanced degree in analytical chemistry, biotechnology, cell and molecular biology, biochemistry, or other related field is preferred.
* Minimum of 8 years biotech based-work experience in cell culture, biochemical, or molecular biology GMP QC testing. Experience with late-stage advanced therapy products is preferred.

* Past experience interacting with health authorities during laboratory inspections.

records.title: Director of Quality and Accreditation
records.description:
Overview:

**Valley Behavioral Health** is seeking an experienced **Director of Quality and Accreditation** to join our team!

Offering the highest quality of treatment in the area, **Valley Behavioral Health** focuses on providing their patients with the tools and knowledge needed to live happy, healthy lives. Regardless of the level of care, patients receive personalized treatment by a multi-disciplinary team of therapists, social workers, psychiatrists, psychiatric nurses, and other caring mental health professionals.

We are seeking a dynamic and experienced **Director of Quality and Accreditation** to lead our facility’s efforts in ensuring the highest standards of patient care and safety. This leadership role is responsible for overseeing regulatory compliance, quality assurance programs, and continuous improvement initiatives across all clinical and operational areas. The Director will guide the development and implementation of quality protocols, manage accreditation processes, and lead the Quality Assurance and Process Improvement (QAPI) program. The ideal candidate will be a proactive, strategic thinker with a strong commitment to achieving excellence in care delivery and regulatory readiness.

**PURPOSE STATEMENT:**

The Director of Quality and Accreditation is responsible for ensuring patient safety and superior quality of care as measured by survey readiness, treatment program fidelity, and compliance with state and federal laws and regulations and accreditation standards. As such, the Director is responsible for leading and overseeing all aspects of policy development; comprehensive implementation of Acadia’s prescribed clinical protocols, operational quality oversight standards, and programmatic expectations; critical incident reporting; regulatory engagement, including development and submission of plans of correction; certification achievement and maintenance; oversight of the quality assurance and process improvement (QAPI) program; and on-going regulatory readiness strategies at the facility. Through routine physical presence in patient care areas, data analysis and documentation monitoring, and intentional sharing of deep subject-matter expertise, the Director will ensure a proactive, multidisciplinary focus on quality and excellence within the facility.

Responsibilities:

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* Lead and monitor day-to-day regulatory readiness, patient safety, and service excellence across the facility.
* QAPI program oversight and management – follow and develop processes for identification, collection, and analysis of quality performance data.
  + Utilize collected data regarding the outcome of activities for delivering continuously improving services.
  + Conduct annual preparation and evaluation of the facility QAPI Program.
  + Complete process improvement projects and incorporate the results into patient care improvements.
  + Submit quality scorecard data to Acadia corporate office as requested.
  + Coordinate the abstraction of clinical data according to Joint Commission specifications and data entry via vendor database for Inpatient Psychiatric Core Measures (ex. national quality measures such as HBIPS).
  + Identify key aspects of care relevant indicators and evaluation of data using formal and informal feedback from consumers of services and other collateral sources is aggregated and used to improve management strategies and service delivery practices.
  + Lead/coordinate data collection and analysis from all departments within the facility.
  + Prepare and present program data trends and action plans to the monthly Quality Council and quarterly to the Medical Executive Committee and the Governing Board.
* Regulatory preparedness – implement sustainable survey preparation and ongoing monitoring processes, including facility-wide auditing and early-issue identification, to maximize achievement of zero- or standard-level survey outcomes.
  + Facility-wide support – collaborate with other departments to sustainably implement best-practices in regulatory/accreditation compliance as evidenced by measurable results with regard to survey outcomes, patient safety metrics, patient experience results, HBIPS, etc.
  + Develop and maintain proficiency in regulatory planning strategy for all standards for all relevant regulatory and accrediting bodies at the local, state, and federal level.
  + Develop and maintain proficiency in the functionality and auditing within electronic platforms such as electronic patient observations and the electronic medical record, as applicable.
  + Lead Root-Cause Analyses and conduct timely and regular evaluation of serious incidents, complaints, grievances and related investigations to:
    - Identification of events, trends and patterns that may affect client health, safety and or treatment efficacy,
    - Committee evaluation findings and recommendations submitted to agency management for corrective action,
    - Implemented actions, outcomes, trends analyzed over time
  + Develop corrective action plans for the resolution of areas of regulatory vulnerability or those which could compromise patient safety in collaboration with other facility leaders.
  + Ensure proper reporting of violations or potential violations to duly authorized enforcement agencies as appropriate and/or required.
  + Ensure proper reporting of incidents and adverse clinical outcomes to duly authorized enforcement agencies or regulatory agencies as appropriate and/or required.
  + In conjunction with assigned corporate Division Quality Director, initiate and lead communications with regulatory agencies as appropriate.
  + Develop sustainable performance improvement practices through analysis of data and prioritization of efforts to improve survey readiness and consistency of care delivery using expected best-practices.
  + Ensure multidisciplinary ownership of best-practices in self-monitoring, auditing, and process improvement, escalating opportunities for improved engagement to the facility CEO as appropriate.
  + Ensures strategic and operational implementation of regulatory requirements, guidelines, and standards of federal, state, and local licensing agencies, accrediting and certifying organizations.
  + Collaborates with Division and Corporate entities and external parties to ensure strategic quality and patient safety initiatives are fully executed at the facility level. Facilitates effective communication with facility and division leadership regarding key clinical performance improvement activities and initiatives.
  + Serves as a technical advisor, educator and internal consultant to all hospital management, staff, and physicians on the use of performance improvement tools and techniques, analytical techniques, and statistical applications.
  + Ensure facility compliance with policies and applicable standards as required by regulatory/accrediting bodies.
  + Facility leader and subject matter expert on high reliability principles and strategies to achieve zero harm.

* Clinical program excellence – assess fidelity and identify root-causes for gaps/lapses in fidelity to Acadia standards. Support other departments in developing and implementing remediation and improvement plans to achieve fidelity to Acadia’s expected practices, including all elements of treatment program implementation.
* + Develop, review, and educate on internal clinical procedures and appropriate use of outcome evaluation tools and the associated results – including patient experience data and other quality scorecard metrics – to ensure continuous quality improvement and ongoing compliance with federal, state, and third-party regulatory requirements.
  + Translate standards, requirements, and policies into terms or processes meaningful to the facility.
* Leadership – serve as a visible, engaged, and dynamic member of the facility leadership team.
  + Chairs the monthly Quality Council
  + Complete safety rounds, participate in leadership rounding, and submit results/corrective actions to Acadia corporate office.
  + Review incident/safety concerns with the leadership team to identify systemic issues and facilitate the development of corrective actions.
  + Lead and facilitate Root Cause Analyses into all serious and/or sentinel events.
  + Invest in the facility staff through engagement in hiring, development, training, performance management, and communication to ensure effective and efficient operations.
  + Oversees the Culture of Safety Survey and follow-up action planning and sustainment processes.
  + Identification of problems or potential problems to prevent risks to patients and staff. Proposes corrective steps that may include, but are not limited to:
    - Changes in policies/procedures,
    - Staffing and assignment changes,
    - Additional education or training for staff,
    - Addition or deletion of services

**OTHER FUNCTIONS:**

* Perform other functions and tasks as assigned.

Qualifications:

**EDUCATION/EXPERIENCE/SKILL REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in Human Services or nursing required. Master’s degree in behavioral health/risk discipline, Registered Nurse preferred.
* Two or more years of experience in a Quality, Clinical, or PI role required.
* One or more years of management experience preferred.
* Experience with CARF, DEA, Joint Commission, or CMS surveys, as required by service line(s) supported

**LICENSES/DESIGNATIONS/CERTIFICATIONS:**

* Current licensure appropriate for the degree held required.
* CPR and de-escalation/restraint certification required (training available upon hire and offered by facility).
* First aid may be required based on state or facility.

**ADDITIONAL REGULATORY REQUIREMENTS:**

***(******e.g.*** ***emergencies, changes in workload, rush jobs or technological developments) dictate.***

records.title: Site Quality Director
records.description:
**Why Us?**

At Par Health, we believe great healthcare is built on getting the essentials right. We’re looking for passionate, talented individuals who share our commitment to improving lives. With a global workforce, we lead with pride and purpose—prioritizing quality and safety while fostering a culture of continuous improvement, accountability, and teamwork. Elevating the Essentials isn’t just our tagline, it’s the higher standard we live by every day.

**Job Description Summary**

The Site Quality Director is responsible for ensuring cGMP compliance and product quality at the Raleigh, NC facility while supporting broader site quality initiatives aligned with company objectives. This role provides strategic leadership in the development, implementation, and oversight of the site quality systems to ensure that all manufacturing, testing, packaging, storage, and distribution activities meet regulatory standards and deliver the highest product quality. The Site Quality Director leads and mentors quality teams, oversees daily quality operations, and serves as a key partner to site leadership by providing guidance on quality and compliance across the organization.

**Job Description**

**ESSENTIAL FUNCTIONS:**

* **Manages all aspects of Site Quality System including but not limited to: CAPA, exceptions, document management, complaint investigation handling, change control, supplier quality, OOS investigations, stability programs, and regulatory inspection readiness.**
* **Support a quality program which instils personal accountability for accuracy, consistency, and completeness for all operations**
* **Provides direction and leadership for the successful execution of quality activities, such as:**
* **Ensures health authority inspection (FDA, EU, Health Canada and others) readiness through development of compliance enhancement plans, internal audit program, and industry intelligence.**
* **Customer complaint investigation, including interaction with customers and resolution of critical issues.**
* **Manages the supplier quality program to fulfill regulatory and site needs.**
* **Conducts and/or administers new employee, ongoing, and directed training on GMP topics to ensure compliance to regulations. Manages site training compliance program.**
* **CAPA program to effectively identify and correct problems that impact product quality or compliance.**
* **Validation activities for new, altered, or modified equipment, facilities, or manufacturing processes.**
* **Customer audit process (approximately 50/yr.) to include preparation, hosting, and responding to issues noted – also, utilize input from customer audits and a continuous improvement tool.**
* **Documents management and label control to fulfill regulatory and business needs**
* **Stability program for both API products manufactured at the site.**
* **Approves highly technical investigations involving product impact.**
* **Sets direction and policies for cGMP compliance activities.**
* **Schedules employees through subordinates, performance appraisals, and performance management of team members.**
* **Budgets and adherence for areas of functional responsibility.**
* **Directly interacting with key customers relating to technical issues, potential non-compliance activities, or service issues impacted by quality/compliance.**
* **Resolution of critical quality issues that could impact production, customer service, quality, or compliance.**
* **Interprets regulatory guidance to determine site course of action for compliance.**
* **Technical expert in multiple quality functional areas, such as validation, product investigations, quality systems, and establishing compliance plans, etc.**

**DEPARTMENT** **SPECIFIC/NON-ESSENTIAL** **FUNCTIONS:**

* **Other duties as assigned with or without accommodation.**
* **Participates in a certified 5S Workplace System to ensure good housekeeping and organization.**

**MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS:**

**Education:**

**BS Chemistry, Engineering, Life Science or related.**

**Experience:**

**7-10 years leadership experience in a chemical or pharmaceutical manufacturing environment, preferably specific to Quality and/or manufacturing related functions.**

**Preferred** **Skills/Qualifications:**

* **Working knowledge of chemical, pharmaceutical or bio-pharmaceutical manufacturing.**
* **Must have knowledge and understanding of applicable global regulations, GMP and compendial requirements.**
* **Must have thorough knowledge and understanding of QA regulations as they apply to this type of facility.**
* **Experience in driving improvements in quality systems and quality performance is preferred.**
* **Certification as a Six Sigma Black or Green Belt and/or as a Certified Quality Engineer is considered a plus.**
* **Must have high technical ability and excellent** **interpersonal/communication** **skills. Requires excellent oral and written skills and good negotiation skills to effectively communicate and influence the outcome of quality related plans, programs, and activities throughout the business unit.**
* **Must have the ability and experience to drive cost reduction while continuously improving performance, as well as the ability to lead employees in making these changes.**

**RELATIONSHIP WITH OTHERS/ SCOPE:**

* **This position reports to the Interim Head of Quality, Generics.**
* **This position will have frequent communication and working relationships with departments and plant managers.**
* **Interacts with internal Staff (Department and Plant Managers) on all Site management issues. Advises Staff on compliance issues. Report on overall performance and critical quality issues to Corporate Quality. Interacts with Corporate Quality personnel, R&D, and quality and managers within the organization. Works with Commercial team on customer issues. External contacts include regulatory authorities, state, federal and international (FDA, OSHA, EPA, NCDENR), suppliers, customers and community contacts.**
* **Financial responsibilities include managing multi-million payroll and operating budgets. Also recommends major purchases and capital expenditures that are necessary to maintain operations of QC laboratory and to maintain or improve the site’s GMP compliance and performance.**

**WORKING CONDITIONS:**

* **70% Office Environment**  
  **30% Laboratory and Plant environment including exposure to raw materials and finished products**
* **Must be willing and able to wear PPE including hard-hat, steel-toed shoes, safety glasses, and any other devices or equipment as specified for the position.**
* **Some travel is required, both domestically and internationally.**

**DISCLAIMER:**

**The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed by employees assigned to this** **classification.** **They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills required of employees assigned to this position.**

**EEO Statement:**

We comply with all applicable federal, state, and local laws prohibiting discrimination and harassment, and provides equal employment opportunities (EEO) to all employees and applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or genetic information, or any other classification protected by federal, state or local law. This policy applies to all terms and conditions of employment, including recruiting, hiring, placement, promotion, termination, layoff, recall, transfer, leaves of absence, compensation and training.

records.title: VP Quality Assurance and Safety
records.description:
**Compensation Range**

$240,000 - $280,000 / Year

**Overview**

**At The Cheesecake Factory Bakery, We Don't Do Ordinary!** Nothing is scaled down. Not the pride, not the fun, and definitely not the teamwork. Here, you’ll have the opportunity to shape the future of our Bakery business, lead great people, and strengthen the systems behind the iconic cheesecakes our guests have loved for decades.

**As the VP, Quality Assurance & Food Safety**, you’ll report to the Bakery President and lead food safety, quality assurance, sanitation, and technical services across two bakery plants totaling more than 160,000 square feet and supporting more than 600 staff members. This is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact: setting the strategy, rebuilding organizational trust, strengthening audit readiness, and elevating Good Manufacturing Practices through disciplined root cause analysis and corrective action. You’ll operate at both the executive and plant levels, bringing the leadership, technical expertise, and influence needed to create lasting change.

**You’ll thrive in this position if you are:**

* **A Trusted Executive Leader:** You build credibility through transparency, sound judgment, and consistent follow-through, earning the confidence to influence decisions at every level.
* **A Strategic, Hands-On Quality Leader:** You set the vision while staying connected to operations, understanding risk, removing barriers, and translating strategy into consistent execution.
* **An Audit and Compliance Expert:** You build a culture of year-round readiness where issues are identified early, corrective actions are effective, and findings are sustainably closed.
* **A Disciplined Problem Solver:** You look beyond the immediate issue, using data, risk assessment, and root cause analysis to solve systemic problems and prevent recurrence.

**Responsibilities**

* Set and lead the Bakery division’s Quality Assurance and Food Safety strategy across both facilities, establishing clear expectations for risk management, performance, and accountability.
* Serve as a trusted advisor to the Bakery President and executive leadership, providing clear perspective on food safety and quality risks, audit readiness, significant incidents, and corrective actions.
* Ensure trust and confidence in the function through technical credibility, transparency, strong partnerships, and consistent execution.
* Strengthen compliance and operational discipline across GMPs, HACCP, SQF, AIB, sanitation, allergen controls, environmental monitoring, traceability, supplier quality, microbiological testing, and recall readiness.
* Establish sustained audit readiness and ensure findings have clear ownership, effective corrective actions, and lasting resolution.
* Ensure highly systematic and disciplined adherence to product and process standards on a real-time basis to guarantee our cakes are beautiful and delicious.
* Build greater rigor around root cause analysis and corrective and preventive actions, addressing systemic issues rather than symptoms.
* Provide leadership across product and process quality, customer complaints, foreign-material controls, product holds, specifications, labeling, formulas, recipes, and Technical Services.
* Establish meaningful metrics and use data to identify trends, prioritize risk, and hold the organization accountable for results.
* Lead significant food safety, quality, sanitation, and regulatory matters with urgency, sound judgment, and appropriate escalation.
* Build and develop a high-performing Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Sanitation, and Technical Services organization with the talent and capabilities needed for long-term success.
* Partner with Operations, Engineering, Supply Chain, Research and Development, and Human Resources to strengthen ownership and accountability for food safety and quality across the business.
* Prioritize resources and investments against the greatest risks and opportunities while effectively managing the function’s budget.

**Qualifications**

* 15+ years of progressive leadership experience in Quality Assurance, Food Safety, Sanitation, or Technical Services within food manufacturing, including senior-level, multi-site responsibility.
* Demonstrated success leading food safety and quality strategy, organizational transformation, culture improvement, and high-performing technical teams.
* Deep expertise in GMPs, HACCP, preventive controls, sanitation, microbiological risk, allergen management, environmental monitoring, traceability, recalls, supplier quality, AIB, SQF, and food safety management systems.
* Extensive experience leading regulatory, certification, customer, and internal audits from preparation through corrective action and sustainable closure.
* Expertise in root cause analysis, corrective and preventive action, risk assessment, and incident investigation.
* Proven ability to build organizational trust, strengthen accountability, influence senior leaders, and lead through significant change.
* Bachelor’s degree in microbiology, chemistry, food science, food safety, biology, engineering, or a closely related discipline.

**What we prefer:**

  

* Leadership experience within the bakery or dessert industry; experience in similarly complex food-manufacturing environments will also be considered.
* Master’s degree in a related technical or business discipline.
* Relevant certifications such as SQF Practitioner, HACCP, PCQI, or Certified Food Scientist.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Benefits**

* Eligible to participate in an annual incentive bonus program
* Eligible for an annual long-term equity award in accordance with company Plan and approval process.
* Medical, Dental & Vision
* Access to a company car or car allowance
* Eligible for benefits on the first day of the month following date of hire
* Flexible vacation
* 5 days of sick time per year (first year prorated)
* Tuition Reimbursement of $2,500 for qualified programs
* Adoption Assistance Benefit of $2,500
* 25%-35% discount when dining as a guest
* Reusable gift card loaded annually for your dining enjoyment

**About the Company**

The Cheesecake Factory Bakery creates over 35,000 delicious cheesecakes per day across our two facilities in Calabasas, CA and Rocky Mount, NC plus other baked products for our restaurants, international licensees, and third-party bakery customers.  
  
The Cheesecake Factory Bakery is a subsidiary of The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated. Recognized as a Fortune 100 Best Companies to Work For® since 2014, The Cheesecake Factory Incorporated is a global $3.8 billion public company with more than 370 casual dining restaurants and over 48,000 staff members.  
  
We are an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive and welcoming workplace for all. We welcome applicants from a wide variety of identities, ideas, perspectives, backgrounds and experiences to apply. The Cheesecake Factory offers reasonable accommodation to job applicants with disabilities.  
  
#SoCheesecake #LifeAtCheesecake  
  
To notify of a non-compliant job posting, please send a notice to ats@thecheesecakefactory.com.

Position Summary

Good Hearts Gear is seeking a strategic, hands-on Vice President of Operations to lead and scale our operational infrastructure. This executive will oversee day-to-day operations while building the systems, processes, and performance standards needed to support growth, customer satisfaction, operational efficiency, and healthy margins.

The VP of Operations will lead key functions including supply chain, inventory, fulfillment, vendor management, production coordination, process improvement, and customer support operations. This role will also oversee the operational execution of private label and custom product programs, ensuring strong quality, timelines, and scalable processes.

The ideal candidate is an experienced operations leader who can think strategically, execute effectively, and collaborate cross-functionally with sales, marketing, e-commerce, and leadership to support revenue growth and product launch success.

Join us and build a career supporting the people who make it all work.
  
  
Overview
  
The Vice President of Distribution Center Operations will lead the product distribution strategy and drive an economically competitive operation that delivers both best-in-class customer experience and distribution cost advantages across all facilities supporting Vestis Rental and Direct Sale customers.
  
This leader will influence and reinforce a portfolio of core values and accountability standards centered on safety, workforce engagement, customer experience, operational efficiency, and innovative solutions that support business goals. This role is responsible for deploying strategies and actionable plans that deliver measurable performance improvement.
  
This leader will also define and advance the technology roadmap for Distribution Center Operations, identifying opportunities to leverage artificial intelligence (AI), robotics, automation, advanced analytics, and other emerging technologies to improve safety, productivity, quality, service, capacity, and cost.
  
The Vice President will promote data-driven performance visibility, real-time corrective action, and strong cross-functional collaboration. This leader will work effectively with business partners to identify, address, and resolve operational issues.
  
This role will set goals and oversee key metrics related to customer fill rates, customer satisfaction, footprint utilization, inventory management, optimization and total DC cost, along with other key measures tied to Distribution Center Operations.
  
Responsibilities/Essential Functions
  

* Set and deliver the overall vision and distribution strategy for national and international distribution centers to ensure end-to-end customer needs are met at the lowest possible cost.
* Lead a high-performing team of supply chain practitioners, with direct and indirect responsibility for an organization of more than 600 employees.
* Partner with Human Resources to design and implement workforce strategies for each distribution center location, including the evolution of workforce skills needed to support increasingly automated and technology-enabled operations.
* Define objectives, establish key performance metrics, and create a regular review cadence across safety, quality, fill rate, customer satisfaction, inventory management, budget performance, and other critical operating areas.
* Implement metrics, processes, and operating routines that drive accountability and ensure results.
* Improve costs year over year through disciplined operational execution and continuous improvement.
* Drive performance improvement through the use of continuous improvement methodology.
* Build strong cross-functional partnerships to identify, escalate, and resolve operational issues and improvement opportunities.
* Set the strategic direction and oversee major projects across national and international locations, including distribution center layout changes, equipment needs, space utilization, capital expenses, major repairs, and related operational requirements.
* Manage domestic and international direct and indirect reporting teams to ensure processes and procedures are consistent across all facilities.
* Lead the annual budgeting process in partnership with DC Operations and Direct Sale Finance Teams and Sales Leadership.
* Stay current on information, technology, and trends affecting functional areas; promote innovation and make appropriate recommendations to executive leadership.
* Develop and execute a multi-year distribution technology and automation roadmap, including the evaluation and adoption of AI, robotics, material-handling automation, advanced analytics, and emerging distribution technologies where they provide measurable operational and financial value.
* Evaluate opportunities to automate manual and repetitive processes across receiving, put-away, inventory movement, picking, packing, sortation, shipping, and related distribution workflows.
* Establish business cases and success measures for major automation and technology investments, including productivity improvement, service impact, safety, capacity, labor requirements, operating cost, capital requirements, and return on investment.
* Partner with Information Technology, Engineering, Supply Chain, Finance, Human Resources, and external technology partners to successfully pilot, scale, and operationalize new distribution technologies across the network.
* Use data, predictive analytics, and AI-enabled decision support to improve demand and capacity planning, inventory positioning, workforce planning, asset utilization, operational visibility, and decision-making.
* Build a culture of innovation in which technology augments the workforce, improves safety and efficiency, and prepares the distribution organization for future operating requirements.
* Set the overall strategy for operational performance planning to drive quality standards and efficiency.
* Oversee and monitor safety and security in accordance with national and international requirements for facilities and employees. Ensure proper training and adherence to company requirements.
* Drive employment decisions and recommendations, including hiring, retention, improvement plans, transfers, promotions, corrective actions, terminations, and pay adjustments.
* Manage employee performance and support improvement through coaching, mentoring, and formal performance reviews.
* Recommend, plan, and implement employee training and skill development activities.
* Lead communication on company and departmental issues, priorities, and goals. Provide oversight of employee growth and development through weekly team meetings, regular one-on-one meetings, coaching, performance management, training, and company-sponsored learning opportunities.

Knowledge/Skills/Abilities
  

* Demonstrated understanding of technical issues within a global distribution framework.
* Strong understanding of modern distribution technologies, including warehouse automation, robotics, AI, machine learning applications, advanced analytics, and automated material-handling solutions.
* Ability to translate emerging technology into practical operational use cases and measurable business outcomes rather than implementing technology for technology’s sake.
* Strong understanding of automation investment strategy, including business-case development, scalability, change management, operational readiness, and return on investment.
* Ability to lead transformation in environments where automated and traditional operations may need to coexist across different facilities.
* Strong project leadership and cross-functional leadership experience.
* Ability to think, plan, and execute strategically.
* Ability to influence and build consensus with executive leadership.
* Comfortable operating in ambiguity.
* Decisive and persuasive, with a strong sense of urgency and a proven ability to drive results.
* Strong organizational skills.
* Excellent analytical skills and technical capabilities.
* Willingness and ability to travel extensively, both nationally and internationally.

Working Environment/Safety Requirements
  
Role is based in Lawrenceville, GA.
  
Requires up to 50% travel across the U.S. and Canada.
  
Work includes distribution center, plant, and office environments, including corporate office interaction in Roswell, GA.
  
Must comply with all company safety, security, and site-specific requirements.
  
Experience/Qualifications

* Recognized thought leader and expert within business, supply chain, logistics, and/or global distribution disciplines.
